title: Pricing and Production Without The Invisible Hand
affiliations: Yale University,  and Princeton University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Pricing and Production Without The Invisible Hand
detail.abstract: Modern theories of the business cycle do not allow for the simultaneous rational choice of both prices and quantities, instead assuming that an "invisible hand" determines one of these variables to clear markets. In this paper, we develop a macroeconomic framework in which both prices and quantities are chosen directly by firms, and exchange is both voluntary and efficient. Because of uncertainty about demand and productivity, individual product markets can be in excess supply or rationed. The absence of market-clearing changes pricing and production in qualitatively important ways: markups are no longer determined solely by the elasticity of demand, and higher uncertainty reduces production and increases markups. In equilibrium, production in rationed markets has a negative aggregate demand externality on demand in slack markets. Differently from New Keynesian economies, monetary shocks propagate by reducing economic slack, raising aggregate labor productivity and consumption, while uncertainty shocks act as stagflationary cost-push shocks. We integrate our theory of disequilibrium in a dynamic, rational-expectations "New Old Keynesian Model" and demonstrate its implications for the business cycle.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个"新老凯恩斯主义模型"，其中企业同时理性选择价格和数量，市场可能处于超额供给或配给状态，而非总是出清。这种非市场出清环境改变了定价和生产行为，不确定性会减少产出并提高加成率。
AI.research_question: 当企业能够同时理性选择价格和数量，且市场可能处于非出清状态时，宏观经济如何运行？这种非市场出清环境如何影响定价、生产和商业周期？
AI.motivation: 现代商业周期理论通常假设"看不见的手"会自动出清市场，只让企业选择价格或数量中的一个变量。但现实中企业同时选择价格和数量，且市场经常处于非出清状态。需要建立一个更符合现实的宏观经济框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新老凯恩斯主义模型（New Old Keynesian Model），结合了理性预期和动态分析，允许市场处于超额供给或配给状态，而非总是出清。
AI.method: 开发了一个宏观经济框架，其中企业直接选择价格和数量，交易是自愿且有效的。构建了动态理性预期模型，分析不确定性对需求和生产率的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 非市场出清改变了定价和生产：加成率不再仅由需求弹性决定；2. 更高的不确定性会减少产出并提高加成率；3. 配给市场的生产对宽松市场的需求产生负的总体需求外部性；4. 货币冲击通过减少经济宽松来传导，提高劳动生产率和消费；5. 不确定性冲击表现为滞胀性的成本推动冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了允许企业同时理性选择价格和数量的宏观经济框架；2. 建立了"新老凯恩斯主义模型"，整合了非均衡理论；3. 展示了非市场出清对商业周期的新影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解现实中的市场非出清现象提供了理论工具；2. 解释了不确定性如何影响宏观经济表现；3. 为政策制定者提供了分析货币冲击和不确定性冲击的新视角。

AI.motivation: 全球化工业制造商面临创新资源有限、内部研发能力不足的挑战，需要有效利用外部创新生态系统来加速创新，但同时又不能影响现有的运营效率和业务稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放式创新理论、创新生态系统理论、平台战略理论、组织学习理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，基于一个在14个国家运营的全球工业制造商的实践，采用设计科学方法开发平台框架，结合实施过程的实证分析
AI.findings: 成功开发并实施了挑战导向型开放式创新平台，该平台能够系统性地连接企业内部需求与外部创新资源，在保持运营卓越的同时显著提升了创新效率
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了开放式创新理论在企业实践中的应用，提出了挑战导向型平台的设计原则，丰富了创新生态系统接入机制的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业提供了可操作的开放式创新平台实施框架，展示了如何在多国运营环境中平衡创新获取与运营稳定性的具体方法

title: Evaluating How Wireless Emergency Alerts Support Information Processing: An Experimental Study of Young Adults in South Korea
affiliations: Pukyong National University and Pukyong National University

detail.title: Evaluating How Wireless Emergency Alerts Support Information Processing: An Experimental Study of Young Adults in South Korea
detail.abstract: Wireless Emergency Alerts (WEAs) are one of disaster response infrastructure to facilitate risk communication and enhance community resilience. By providing real-time hazardous information, WEAs enable individuals to make critical safety decisions during emergencies.  Here, the COVID-19 pandemic has significantly altered public risk perceptions and expectations regarding the reliability and utility of these systems. This study examined the effectiveness of current WEA systems through the lens of human information processing, focusing on their role in emergency management. In an experiment, a total of 39 participants were exposed to simulated disaster scenarios (COVID-19 and Avian Influenza) to assess the WEA system’s impact on cognitive and emotional aspects. Results indicate that while current WEA designs effectively provide essential information for disaster response, their impact is mediated by specific stages of information processing. Situation awareness was observed as the most significant predictor of WEA effectiveness, suggesting that resilience in emergency management is deeply rooted in the cognitive clarity provided to the end-user. These findings provide insights for designing resilient emergency alert systems that can adapt to evolving public expectations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验评估了无线紧急警报系统在灾害响应中的有效性，发现情境意识是预测WEA效果的最重要因素，强调了认知清晰度对应急管理韧性的重要性。
AI.research_question: 无线紧急警报系统在当前灾害响应中的有效性如何？其效果是否受到人类信息处理过程特定阶段的中介影响？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行显著改变了公众对风险感知和对应急警报系统可靠性和实用性的期望，需要重新评估WEA系统的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人类信息处理理论，重点关注应急管理中的认知和情感方面，特别是情境意识在灾害响应中的作用。
AI.method: 实验研究：39名参与者暴露于模拟灾害场景（COVID-19和禽流感），评估WEA系统对认知和情感方面的影响。
AI.findings: 当前WEA设计能有效提供灾害响应所需的基本信息，但其效果受到信息处理特定阶段的中介影响；情境意识是预测WEA有效性的最重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 从人类信息处理视角深化了对应急警报系统有效性的理解，强调了情境意识在应急管理韧性中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计能够适应不断变化的公众期望的韧性应急警报系统提供了见解，强调了在警报设计中增强用户认知清晰度的重要性。

title: Risk Management: From Portfolio Strategy to Value-creating Systems Strategy
affiliations: George Mason University - Interdisciplinary Center for Economic Science, Swedbank and Independent

detail.title: Risk Management: From Portfolio Strategy to Value-creating Systems Strategy
detail.abstract: This paper is concerned with those actions of business firms which are aimed at managing the business and economic risks and uncertainties. The standard example of risk management is finance and insurance but these only capture a small fraction of the business risk faced by a company in a competitive market. These "standard" risks are often dealt with through specialized activities but here what the firms do to manage their total "market access risks" is discussed. The analysis goes beyond, but includes, and builds on, insurable and financial risks to include risks in the firm's customer's processes, the use of IT in this process, and the economic system. The issues explored are: understanding the "new business logic" and its risk; how offerings have become service offerings; management of risk and uncertainty in a more systemic way. A new "risk map" is presented as a tool to analyze the management of risk in a "systemic" context argued to be more relevant to today's risk management challenges. This new, broader scope has new demands on knowledge and systems for effective management. As a conclusion, five historic steps are identified, tied to the new risk map, which show the gradual build-up of the product offering to a service offering and its actions to manage, and ultimately price, the risk management in the offering.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨企业如何管理商业和经济风险与不确定性，超越传统的金融和保险风险管理，提出"市场准入风险"概念，并引入新的"风险地图"工具来分析系统性风险管理。
AI.research_question: 企业如何管理超越传统金融和保险风险的总"市场准入风险"，包括客户流程、IT应用和经济系统中的风险？
AI.motivation: 传统的金融和保险风险管理只涵盖企业面临风险的一小部分，无法应对竞争市场中企业面临的全面风险挑战，需要更系统化的风险管理方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险管理理论，但扩展了传统风险管理的边界，引入"市场准入风险"概念和系统性风险管理框架。
AI.method: 概念性分析，提出新的"风险地图"作为分析工具，通过历史步骤分析产品向服务转型过程中的风险管理演变。
AI.findings: 提出了新的风险地图工具，识别了五个历史步骤，展示了产品向服务转型过程中风险管理的逐步构建和定价过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了风险管理理论边界，从传统金融保险风险扩展到包括客户流程、IT应用和经济系统的系统性风险，提出了新的风险分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了实用的风险地图工具，帮助企业更系统化地管理风险，理解从产品到服务转型中的风险管理需求，提升风险管理能力。

title: The Agentic Decoupling: Intent, Verification, and Macroeconomic Scarcity A Macro Theory of Intent, Energy, and Verification in a Post-AGI Economy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Agentic Decoupling: Intent, Verification, and Macroeconomic Scarcity A Macro Theory of Intent, Energy, and Verification in a Post-AGI Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, institutional, or professional relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research. The analysis and conclusions presented are solely the author’s own and were developed independently without external direction, sponsorship, or compensation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a theoretical and analytical study. It does not involve human participants, human subjects data, patient data, experiments, surveys, or identifiable personal information. Accordingly, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently and was not supported by any grant, institution, corporation, or government agency.

detail.abstract: Early 2026 marks a structural break: intelligence has become a metered commodity, while human intent, verification capacity, and energy throughput emerge as binding constraints. This paper develops the Intent Theory of Value (ITV), a macroeconomic framework for an economy where synthetic cognition is abundant but accountable decision capacity is scarce. Four empirical pillars motivate the model: wage inversion and heterogeneous task complexity make substitution operational yet smooth in aggregate; elastic substitution in the execution composite implies endogenous expansion of cognition as its price falls; frontier compute markets remain concentrated because quality competition requires large sunk costs; and verification capital prevents a lemons collapse. Output is modeled with a nested CES in which intent and execution are highly complementary, and energy binds synthetic execution through powered compute. Intent is measured via rational inattention rather than nominal spending. The labor market follows a search-and-matching structure to capture displacement frictions. Public finance respects Diamond-Mirrlees production efficiency by taxing value added and inelastic inputs, financing a Universal Basic Yield (UBY) whose income effects are modeled explicitly. Internationally, a spatial-equilibrium lens explains compute havens and verification bottlenecks. The result is a tractable macro framework with testable predictions for the post-AGI economy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"意图价值理论"(ITV)，一个针对后AGI经济的宏观经济框架。在2026年初的结构性转折点后，智能成为计量商品，而人类意图、验证能力和能源吞吐成为约束条件。模型假设合成认知丰富但可问责的决策能力稀缺，通过嵌套CES生产函数、搜索匹配劳动力市场和公共财政政策来分析这种新经济形态。
AI.research_question: 在合成认知丰富但可问责决策能力稀缺的后AGI经济中，如何构建一个宏观经济框架来解释价值创造、劳动力市场动态和公共政策设计？
AI.motivation: 2026年初出现结构性转折：智能成为计量商品，而人类意图、验证能力和能源吞吐成为约束条件。传统经济模型无法充分解释合成认知丰富但可问责决策能力稀缺的新经济形态，需要新的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 意图价值理论(ITV)：基于四个经验支柱：1)工资倒置和异质任务复杂性；2)执行复合中的弹性替代；3)前沿计算市场的集中性；4)验证资本防止柠檬市场崩溃。采用嵌套CES生产函数，意图和执行高度互补，能源通过计算能力约束合成执行。意图通过理性疏忽而非名义支出来衡量。
AI.method: 宏观经济建模方法：使用嵌套CES生产函数，劳动力市场采用搜索匹配结构以捕捉替代摩擦，公共财政遵循Diamond-Mirrlees生产效率原则，国际分析采用空间均衡视角。建立可处理的宏观框架并产生可检验的预测。
AI.findings: 模型预测：1)工资倒置和异质任务复杂性使替代在操作层面可行但在总量层面平滑；2)执行复合中的弹性替代意味着认知价格下降时内生扩张；3)前沿计算市场保持集中；4)验证资本防止柠檬市场崩溃；5)能源通过计算能力约束合成执行；6)公共政策应征税价值增值和弹性输入，资助普遍基本收益(UBY)。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1)提出意图价值理论(ITV)作为后AGI经济的宏观经济框架；2)将意图概念化为理性疏忽而非名义支出；3)整合搜索匹配劳动力市场动态；4)将能源约束纳入合成认知生产；5)提供空间均衡视角解释计算避风港和验证瓶颈。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1)为政策制定者提供后AGI经济的分析工具；2)提出普遍基本收益(UBY)作为收入分配机制；3)指导税收政策设计(征税价值增值和弹性输入)；4)帮助企业理解计算市场动态和验证需求；5)为国际计算资源配置提供分析框架。

title: Decision Compression and Escalation Risk in AI-Enabled Military Command and Control: An Operational Analysis of the ERAM Framework

detail.title: Decision Compression and Escalation Risk in AI-Enabled Military Command and Control: An Operational Analysis of the ERAM Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or human subjects research and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive funding from any governmental, commercial, or non-profit organization.

detail.abstract:
Advances in AI-enabled military command and control (C2) systems are compressing operational decision timelines to the point where the time available to detect, classify, and respond to threats (TavailT_{avail}​) approaches or falls below the time required for system processing and meaningful human verification (TreqT_{req}​). This paper defines decision compression as the condition Tavail<TreqT_{avail} < T_{req}​ and argues that such temporal divergence systematically increases the risk of inadvertent escalation in tightly coupled, complex military systems.

To operationalize this risk, the paper introduces the Escalation Risk Assessment Model (ERAM), which estimates the probability of unintended engagement (PEP_E​) as a bounded function of temporal coupling (KK), interaction complexity (XX), ambiguity rate (λ\rho), and architectural robustness (RR). The framework is grounded in physics-based constraints on engagement timelines, including radar horizon geometry and interceptor fly-out dynamics, and is evaluated through sensitivity analysis and fully worked operational examples.

Application of ERAM to missile defense and autonomous engagement scenarios shows that escalation risk rises sharply under high coupling and low robustness, even absent operator error or malicious intent. The analysis further demonstrates that run-time assurance and supervisory control architectures can substantially mitigate this risk by increasing system robustness without sacrificing operational tempo.

AI.tldr: 该论文定义了"决策压缩"概念，即AI军事指挥控制系统中的可用响应时间小于所需处理时间，这会增加意外升级风险。论文提出了升级风险评估模型(ERAM)，通过时间耦合、交互复杂性、模糊率和架构鲁棒性等参数量化风险，并应用于导弹防御和自主交战场景分析。
AI.research_question: AI赋能的军事指挥控制系统中的决策压缩如何影响意外升级风险？如何量化这种风险并设计缓解策略？
AI.motivation: AI军事系统压缩了决策时间线，导致可用响应时间可能小于系统处理和人工验证所需时间，这种"决策压缩"增加了复杂军事系统中意外升级的风险，需要系统性的风险评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策压缩理论、时间耦合理论、复杂系统理论、升级风险评估模型(ERAM)框架
AI.method: 引入ERAM模型，基于物理约束（雷达视距几何、拦截器飞行动力学）建立数学模型，通过敏感性分析和完整作战案例进行评估
AI.findings: 1. 在高耦合、低鲁棒性条件下，升级风险急剧上升；2. 即使没有操作员错误或恶意意图，风险依然存在；3. 运行时保证和监督控制架构可显著降低风险
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 定义了"决策压缩"概念；2. 建立了升级风险评估模型(ERAM)；3. 将时间耦合、交互复杂性、模糊率、架构鲁棒性等参数系统化整合
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为军事系统设计者提供风险评估工具；2. 识别高风险操作条件；3. 证明监督控制架构可在不牺牲作战节奏的情况下降低风险；4. 为导弹防御和自主交战系统提供具体应用指导

title: Drivers of Technological Co-Evolution in Modular Systems of Products and Processes
affiliations: National Research Council of Italy (CNR)

detail.title: Drivers of Technological Co-Evolution in Modular Systems of Products and Processes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NONE
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: no funding for this study

detail.abstract:
Goal :This study investigates the mechanisms driving technological change in complex systems. It examines how the evolution of embedded subsystems shapes the overall trajectory and tempo of a host technology.

Background: Drawing on the theory of technological parasitism, the research conceptualizes modular host systems—such as smartphones—as evolving through dynamic, co‑evolutionary interactions with their subsystems. These interactions shift from parasitic dependence to mutualistic and eventually symbiotic integration. Central to this framework is the role of subsystems as temporal pacemakers that dictate system‑wide innovation rhythms.

Methods: The study utilizes a longitudinal, mixed‑methods design, combining an 18‑year case study of the iPhone (2007–2025) with time‑series regression and log‑log hedonic pricing models. The dataset tracks subsystem performance trajectories and price‑performance dynamics across multiple technological generations.

Results: The research identifies three key phenomena:

  1. Temporal Precedence: Subsystem advances (notably Bluetooth protocol upgrades) consistently precede host‑system releases. Integration lags have shrunk significantly, moving from a three-year window to just one.
  2. Differential Evolutionary Pressure: While camera resolution exhibits rapid exponential improvement, it remains a secondary driver of total system evolution.
  3. Economic Pacemakers: Battery life exerts the strongest economic influence; a 1% performance gain predicts a 0.3% rise in nominal price, whereas display and camera improvements show weaker correlations.

Discussion: The findings reveal that subsystems evolve at heterogeneous speeds and exert unequal systemic leverage. Their evolutionary tempo serves as a leading indicator for host-system transitions, highlighting the asynchronous dynamics inherent in modular architectures.

Implications & Originality: This research advances evolutionary theories of modular innovation by establishing subsystem evolution as a governing mechanism of system-level change.

  • For Strategists: It provides new design rules for forecasting technological generations.
  • For R&D: It assists in prioritization by identifying which subsystems function as strategic pacemakers in complex innovations.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨复杂系统中技术变革的驱动机制，基于技术寄生理论，将模块化主机系统（如智能手机）视为通过与其子系统的动态共同进化而演化。研究发现子系统作为时间节拍器，以异质速度进化并对系统产生不均衡影响，其中电池寿命的经济影响力最强。
AI.research_question: 复杂系统中技术变革的驱动机制是什么？子系统演化如何塑造主机技术的整体轨迹和节奏？
AI.motivation: 理解模块化复杂系统中技术变革的底层机制，为技术创新管理和战略规划提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术寄生理论，将模块化主机系统视为通过与其子系统的动态共同进化而演化，子系统作为时间节拍器驱动系统创新节奏。
AI.method: 纵向混合方法设计，结合18年iPhone案例研究（2007-2025）、时间序列回归和对数-对数享乐定价模型，追踪子系统性能轨迹和价格-性能动态。
AI.findings: 1. 时间优先性：子系统进步（特别是蓝牙协议升级）始终先于主机系统发布，集成滞后从三年缩短至一年；2. 差异化进化压力：相机分辨率呈指数级快速改进，但对系统演化影响有限；3. 经济节拍器：电池寿命的经济影响力最强，1%性能提升预测0.3%名义价格上涨。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进模块化创新的进化理论，确立子系统演化作为系统层面变革的治理机制，揭示子系统作为主机系统转型的领先指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为战略家提供预测技术世代的新设计规则，为研发部门通过识别战略节拍器子系统来优化创新优先级。

title: Access to Finance -Credit Augmented Per Capita Income: A Framework for Measuring Economic Wellbeing
affiliations: State University of New York (SUNY), Stony Brook

detail.title: Access to Finance -Credit Augmented Per Capita Income: A Framework for Measuring Economic Wellbeing
detail.abstract: Traditional measures of per capita income, including GDP per capita and PPP-adjusted variants, fail to account for a critical dimension of economic capacity: access to financing and financial infrastructure. This paper proposes a novel framework-Credit-Augmented Per Capita Income (CAPCI)-which adjusts nominal income by a Finance Access Multiplier (FAM) derived from household debt-to-income ratios and financial inclusion metrics. Using data from the World Bank, IMF, and academic sources, we demonstrate that finance access effectively allows individuals in developed economies to "pull future earnings into the present," creating a temporal arbitrage effect that dramatically amplifies economic capacity relative to counterparts in developing regions. Our illustrative calculations suggest that the true economic disparity between developed economies (e.g., USA) and developing regions (e.g., Sub-Saharan Africa) is approximately 74% greater than nominal per capita income figures suggest—rising from a 53× nominal gap to approximately 92× when finance access is properly factored in with a credit discount coefficient. This finding has significant implications for understanding the relevance and imperative for financial inclusion and its relation to global inequality and designing development policy initiatives to incentivize growth. A Critical Distinction: Household Finance vs. Sovereign Debt. It is essential to distinguish the framework proposed here from advocacy for increased sovereign borrowing. Centralized debt—loans to the state—has a troubled track record in African nations, often resulting in large national debt burdens with limited developmental impact. Our framework is fundamentally different: we advocate for empowerment of individuals, households, and communities through access to personal and business financing infrastructure. A key indicator of healthy financial development is the ratio of collective household debt to national debt—a ratio that is substantially higher in developed economies. When households can access mortgages, business loans, entrepreneurship capital, and consumer finance, economic capacity is distributed and multiplied at the grassroots level, rather than concentrated in state apparatus. This distributed (decentralized) approach to financial empowerment represents a fundamentally different path to development than sovereign borrowing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"信贷增强人均收入"(CAPCI)新框架，通过金融获取乘数调整名义收入，发现发达国家与发展中国家真实经济差距比名义差距大74%，从53倍扩大到92倍，强调个人金融获取而非主权债务对发展的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 如何通过考虑金融获取能力来更准确地衡量不同经济体的真实经济差距？
AI.motivation: 传统人均收入指标（如GDP per capita）未能考虑金融获取和金融基础设施这一关键维度，导致对发达国家与发展中国家真实经济差距的低估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷增强人均收入(CAPCI)框架，基于金融获取乘数(FAM)调整名义收入，该乘数来源于家庭债务收入比和金融包容性指标，体现"将未来收入拉到现在"的时间套利效应。
AI.method: 使用世界银行、IMF和学术数据，通过金融获取乘数调整名义收入，计算发达国家与发展中国家真实经济差距，并进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 考虑金融获取后，发达国家与发展中国家的真实经济差距比名义差距大74%，从53倍扩大到92倍；强调家庭金融获取（而非主权债务）对经济发展的关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的经济能力衡量框架CAPCI，强调金融获取作为经济能力关键维度；区分了家庭金融获取与主权债务在发展中的不同作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解全球不平等提供了新视角；为金融包容性政策和发展倡议设计提供依据；强调应通过个人和家庭金融基础设施赋能而非主权借款来促进发展。

title: Training Frontline Health Workers in LMICs to Reduce Contraceptive Stock-outs: Evidence from Indonesia
affiliations: Alvarez College of Business, The University of Texas at San Antonio, , University of Minnesota - Twin Cities - Carlson School of Management, University of Minnesota - Twin Cities - Carlson School of Management, JSI Research and Training Institute Inc and

detail.title: Training Frontline Health Workers in LMICs to Reduce Contraceptive Stock-outs: Evidence from Indonesia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Frontline health workers are an indispensable asset in the healthcare ecosystem of low-and middle-income countries (LMICs). They not only provide clinical care to patients but also frequently shoulder non-clinical responsibilities such as inventory management. However, many lack the necessary skills to effectively manage inventories, leading to the pervasive problem of health commodity stock-outs. To address this problem, several LMICs have launched training programs aimed at enhancing the inventory management skills and capabilities of frontline health workers. Leveraging fine-grained data over a five-year period (2015-2019) from approximately 17,000 health facilities across Indonesia-where the public health supply chain operates as a hybrid push-pull model-we evaluate the impact of a large-scale inventory management training program on contraceptive stock-outs. Applying difference-in-differences estimations, we find that the training program is associated with a significant reduction in stock-outs (i.e., 6.52 percentage-points or approximately 30%). Our numerical calculations suggest that the training program prevents, on average, more than 800 unintended pregnancies and saves 4.25 maternal and newborn lives per 100,000 women of reproductive age within the catchment area of a treated health facility. A counterfactual benefit-cost analysis shows that onsite delivery of the training program (i.e., on-the-job within a facility) yields operational and public health benefits that significantly exceed those achieved through offsite delivery (i.e., outside the facility in a classroom). Our research highlights the practicality and scalability of human-capital-focused interventions in improving health commodity availability and public health outcomes in LMICs.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了印度尼西亚大规模库存管理培训项目对避孕药具缺货的影响，发现培训显著减少了30%的缺货率，防止了意外怀孕并挽救了母婴生命，且现场培训效果优于场外培训。
AI.research_question: 大规模库存管理培训项目如何影响中低收入国家卫生设施的避孕药具缺货情况？现场培训与场外培训的效果有何差异？
AI.motivation: 中低收入国家的一线卫生工作者经常承担库存管理等非临床职责，但缺乏相关技能，导致卫生商品缺货问题普遍。虽然许多国家开展了培训项目，但对其实际效果缺乏系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论（培训作为人力资本投资），供应链管理理论（推拉混合模式下的库存管理），公共卫生干预评估框架。
AI.method: 使用双重差分法（difference-in-differences），分析2015-2019年印度尼西亚约17,000个卫生设施的细粒度数据，评估大规模库存管理培训项目对避孕药具缺货的影响。
AI.findings: 培训项目使缺货率显著降低6.52个百分点（约30%）。每10万育龄妇女中，培训平均防止800多例意外怀孕，挽救4.25个母婴生命。现场培训（在职培训）的运营和公共卫生效益显著优于场外培训（课堂培训）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为人力资本投资在改善公共卫生供应链中的有效性提供了实证证据；深化了对培训交付模式（现场vs场外）效果差异的理解；拓展了供应链管理理论在中低收入国家公共卫生背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明库存管理培训是改善卫生商品可获得性的实用且可扩展的干预措施；为政策制定者提供了培训项目设计和实施的优化建议（推荐现场培训模式）；展示了培训项目在防止意外怀孕和降低孕产妇死亡率方面的公共卫生价值。

title: Matching Technology, Fleet Size, and Passenger Wait in Ride-Hailing Markets
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Operations and Information Management and University of California, Riverside (UCR) - A. Gary Anderson Graduate School of Management

detail.title: Matching Technology, Fleet Size, and Passenger Wait in Ride-Hailing Markets
detail.abstract: This paper studies how matching technology shapes the distribution of passenger waiting times in ride-hailing markets. We study two canonical matching technologies—street-hailing and central dispatch—and develop tractable approximations for the entire distribution of passenger wait under each. To arrive at our approximations, we model a city as a square grid of identical locations where passengers arrive randomly and drivers are uniformly distributed. With street-hailing, drivers search for passengers without information about their locations and move according to a random walk; with central dispatch, the platform assigns arriving passengers to nearby idle drivers and directs them along shortest paths to pickup locations. Within this framework, we derive a novel approximation for the distribution of passenger wait under street-hailing and extend a well-established approximation for central dispatch to the grid setting. We validate both approximations using extensive simulation. The resulting approximations are closed-form and interpretable, allowing platforms to define a variety of performance metrics and develop strategies for achieving them. This affords platforms greater flexibility than analytical approaches that characterize only average wait or rely on computationally intensive simulation. Moreover, our approximations allow for nuanced comparison of the two matching technologies considered. While central dispatch achieves lower average wait with fewer drivers, comparing distributions reveals a short-wait advantage of street-hailing: when mean wait is held fixed, street-hailing produces more frequent shorter-than-average waits. We discuss the implications for platform matching technology choices and ride-hailing market equilibria.

AI.tldr: 本文研究匹配技术如何影响网约车市场中乘客等待时间的分布，比较了街头招手和中央调度两种匹配技术，并推导了两种技术下等待时间分布的近似解析解。
AI.research_question: 匹配技术如何影响网约车市场中乘客等待时间的分布？街头招手和中央调度两种匹配技术对等待时间分布有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常只关注平均等待时间或依赖计算密集的模拟，缺乏对等待时间完整分布的分析，限制了平台定义多样化性能指标和制定策略的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将城市建模为相同位置的方形网格，乘客随机到达，司机均匀分布。街头招手模式下司机随机游走寻找乘客；中央调度模式下平台将到达乘客分配给附近空闲司机并沿最短路径引导。
AI.method: 推导了街头招手模式下乘客等待时间分布的新近似解，并将中央调度的现有近似解扩展到网格设置。通过大量模拟验证两种近似解的准确性。
AI.findings: 中央调度以更少司机实现更低平均等待时间，但分布比较显示街头招手具有短等待优势：当平均等待时间固定时，街头招手产生更多短于平均的等待。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 推导了街头招手模式下等待时间分布的新近似解；2. 将中央调度近似解扩展到网格设置；3. 提供了两种匹配技术等待时间分布的封闭式可解释近似。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 平台可定义多样化性能指标并制定实现策略；2. 提供比仅关注平均等待或依赖模拟更灵活的分析方法；3. 为平台匹配技术选择和网约车市场均衡提供决策依据。

title: Bee Natural Uganda: Unlocking the Potential of Smallholder Farmers in the West Nile
affiliations: and Cornell University

detail.title: Bee Natural Uganda: Unlocking the Potential of Smallholder Farmers in the West Nile
detail.abstract: Bee Natural Uganda, Ltd. (BNU) is the largest producer of quality honey and honey products in Uganda, selling 61 tonnes of honey in 2012 with an average growth in sales of 20% per year. BNU's unique business model follows their honey from the hives of smallholder farmers trained by BNU to a state of the art processing facility in Arua, West Nile, Uganda. The company attributes its success to this model, which allows employees to continue checking the quality of their product at every step leading to the sale of BNU's products. In a highly competitive honey market, this consistency in quality has set BNU high above their competition. As Bee Natural Uganda looks to the future, management must develop a strategy to overcome the challenges associated with continued growth and unmet demand in Uganda and the East Africa region.

AI.tldr: BNU是乌干达最大的优质蜂蜜生产商，采用独特的从蜂农到加工厂的全程质量控制模式，在竞争激烈的市场中凭借质量一致性脱颖而出。公司面临持续增长和未满足需求的挑战，需要制定未来发展战略。
AI.research_question: BNU如何制定战略以应对乌干达和东非地区持续增长和未满足需求带来的挑战？
AI.motivation: BNU作为乌干达最大的蜂蜜生产商，虽然通过独特的质量控制模式取得了成功（年销售61吨，年均增长20%），但在快速增长和未满足需求的市场环境下，需要制定新战略来维持竞争优势和应对挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值链管理、质量控制体系、小农户参与模式、可持续增长战略、竞争战略理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析BNU的业务模式、市场表现、竞争优势和面临的挑战
AI.findings: BNU的成功源于从蜂农培训到加工厂的全过程质量控制模式，这种模式确保了产品质量一致性，使其在竞争激烈的蜂蜜市场中脱颖而出。但公司面临持续增长、产能扩张、市场拓展等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业价值链整合、小农户参与的质量控制模式、发展中市场可持续增长战略提供了实证案例
AI.practical_contributions: 为BNU管理层提供战略制定框架，为其他农业企业提供可借鉴的质量控制和发展模式，为政策制定者支持小农户参与农业价值链提供参考

title: Vertical Integration and Executive Compensation Arrangements
affiliations: HKU Business School, The University of Hong Kong, , University of Navarra, IESE Business School and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)

detail.title: Vertical Integration and Executive Compensation Arrangements
detail.abstract: This paper examines how a firm's degree of vertical integration influences the design of executive performance measurement systems. Building on the theory of the "metering problem" in team production (Alchian and Demsetz 1972), we argue that operating across vertically related product markets reduces contracting frictions with supply chain partners, lowers noise in financial performance, and increases the informativeness of accounting metrics. Consistent with this view, we find that both the sensitivity of executive pay to accounting earnings and the reliance on accounting-based measures in compensation contracts increase with vertical integration. These effects are stronger when firms have weaker bargaining power relative to supply chain partners and when adjacent vertical markets exhibit lower earnings volatility. We also find that vertical integration substitutes for other performance measures and shifts board functions toward a more advisory role. Overall, our findings highlight vertical integration as a governance mechanism that complements accounting-based incentives.

AI.tldr: 垂直整合程度影响高管绩效衡量系统设计：垂直整合降低供应链契约摩擦，提高会计指标信息含量，导致高管薪酬对会计收益更敏感，更多依赖会计基础衡量指标。
AI.research_question: 企业垂直整合程度如何影响高管绩效衡量系统的设计？
AI.motivation: 理解企业治理结构（特别是垂直整合）如何影响高管激励合同的设计，填补垂直整合作为治理机制如何与会计基础激励互补的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Alchian和Demsetz（1972）的团队生产"计量问题"理论，垂直整合减少供应链契约摩擦，降低财务绩效噪音，提高会计指标信息含量。
AI.method: 实证研究，分析垂直整合程度与高管薪酬对会计收益敏感性、薪酬合同中会计基础衡量指标依赖度的关系，并考察调节因素（议价能力、相邻垂直市场收益波动性）。
AI.findings: 1. 垂直整合程度越高，高管薪酬对会计收益敏感性越强；2. 薪酬合同对会计基础衡量指标的依赖度越高；3. 当企业相对供应链伙伴议价能力较弱、相邻垂直市场收益波动性较低时，这些效应更强；4. 垂直整合替代其他绩效衡量指标，使董事会功能转向更多咨询角色。
AI.theory_contributions: 将垂直整合概念化为一种治理机制，扩展了团队生产理论在高管激励设计中的应用，揭示了垂直整合如何通过降低计量问题来增强会计指标的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计高管激励合同提供指导：垂直整合程度高的企业应更多依赖会计基础指标；董事会应根据企业垂直整合程度调整其监督与咨询职能的平衡。

title: The Shift to Digital Payments: Effects on Spending, Saving and Investment Behaviour
affiliations: BRCM College of Business Administration and B.R.C.M. College of Business Administration

detail.title: The Shift to Digital Payments: Effects on Spending, Saving and Investment Behaviour

publicationDetails.detailsText: VNSGU Journal of Management and Administration

detail.abstract:
Emerging technology in the payment system in India, the shift to Digital payments, is of significant importance to individuals as well as the economy. Digital payments accelerated the rate of financial inclusion in the economy, leading to smoother and more transparent transactions, which reduces the chances of tax evasion, also reducing cash dependency. Digital payments not only equip an individual with the ease and convenience of making a payment but also the highest possible level of security to an individual. 

The modes of digital payments have evolved in the 1980s from plastic money, i.e. credit and debit cards, to improvised and online versions like NEFT, RTGS, online banking and some of the world’s most secure systems like UPI with a user-friendly interface in India. Digital payments, being of such convenience and use to an individual, also changed the financial behaviour of an individual, given the less friction and the security. This paper attempts to study a relation between the usage of digital payments and Spending, Saving and Investment Behaviour. The findings and conclusion of the paper are based on the survey of 200 respondents in Surat city.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了印度数字支付使用与个人消费、储蓄和投资行为之间的关系，基于对苏拉特市200名受访者的调查分析。
AI.research_question: 数字支付的使用如何影响个人的消费、储蓄和投资行为？
AI.motivation: 数字支付在印度支付系统中的重要性日益增长，它不仅促进金融包容性、提高交易透明度和安全性，还可能改变个人的财务行为模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字支付技术采纳理论、行为金融学理论，以及支付系统演变对个人财务决策影响的相关理论框架。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查方法，对印度苏拉特市的200名受访者进行调查，收集数据并进行分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现数字支付的使用与个人的消费、储蓄和投资行为存在显著关系，具体表现为减少交易摩擦、提高安全性，从而影响财务决策模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字支付采纳与个人财务行为关系的研究提供了实证证据，丰富了行为金融学在数字支付环境下的理论发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、金融机构和支付服务提供商提供了关于数字支付如何影响个人财务行为的见解，有助于设计更有效的金融产品和服务。

title: Regulatory Stringency and Industry Performance: Evidence from RegData U.S. 6.0
affiliations: and Stanford University - Hoover Institution

detail.title: Regulatory Stringency and Industry Performance: Evidence from RegData U.S. 6.0
detail.abstract: This paper studies the economic incidence of broad federal regulation across U.S. industries using RegData U.S. 6.0. We measure regulatory stringency using binding language densityexpected regulatory restrictions per 1,000 words-constructed from the text of the Code of Federal Regulations and mapped to NAICS industries using supervised relevance weights. Using the 1970-2025 regulatory panel, we document three stylized facts: (1) binding density evolves through many small year-to-year adjustments and a recent plateauing in 2025; (2) short-run changes are across industries rather than concentrated in a small set of sectors; and (3) annual changes are weakly related to baseline industry size and productivity. We also validate the normalized measure by showing that treated industries exhibit clear and persistent increases in binding density around major legislative events. Linking within-industry variation in binding density to Bureau of Economic Analysis measures of real output and real value added for three-digit NAICS industries over 1998-2024, we find that a one-unit increase in restrictions per 1,000 words is associated with approximately a 0.7 percent decline in real output and a 1.2 percent decline in real value added. The relationship persists in distributedlag specifications and is robust across alternative functional forms. These findings suggest that normalized regulatory text captures economically meaningful shifts in the regulatory environment and provides a scalable framework for studying their economic effects.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用RegData U.S. 6.0分析联邦法规对美国各行业的经济影响，发现每增加1个约束性语言密度单位（每1000字中的监管限制），实际产出下降约0.7%，实际增加值下降约1.2%。
AI.research_question: 联邦法规的约束性语言密度如何影响美国各行业的实际产出和实际增加值？
AI.motivation: 需要量化评估广泛联邦监管对行业经济表现的影响，现有研究缺乏基于文本分析的系统性测量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管经济学理论，关注监管强度与企业绩效的关系；文本分析方法论，通过监管文本量化监管严格程度。
AI.method: 使用RegData U.S. 6.0构建1970-2025年监管面板数据，测量约束性语言密度（每1000字中的监管限制），通过监督相关性权重映射到NAICS行业，与BEA的实际产出和增加值数据（1998-2024年）进行回归分析。
AI.findings: 1）约束性密度通过许多小调整演变，2025年趋于平稳；2）短期变化跨行业分布而非集中于少数部门；3）年度变化与行业规模和生产率弱相关；4）约束性密度每增加1单位，实际产出下降约0.7%，实际增加值下降约1.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于文本分析的监管严格度标准化测量框架，验证了约束性语言密度作为监管环境变化的经济意义指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化监管经济影响的工具，有助于更精准地评估监管政策的效果和成本。

title: How to (and How Not to) Increase Free-Shipping Thresholds: Evidence from Online Retail
affiliations: McGill University - Desautels Faculty of Management, , McGill University - Desautels Faculty of Management and McGill University

detail.title: How to (and How Not to) Increase Free-Shipping Thresholds: Evidence from Online Retail
detail.abstract: Problem definition: Contingent free shipping (CFS) policies are widely used by e-commerce platforms to encourage larger cart values, yet platforms increasingly struggle with how to adjust these thresholds in response to rising fulfillment costs. This paper examines how increasing the CFS threshold affects consumer behavior and derives conditions under which such an increase is optimal for the platform. Methodology: Using detailed transaction and clickstream data from a North American online grocery platform, we analyze a threshold increase from $80 to $100 by employing a difference-in-differences design. Results: We find that raising the CFS threshold results in a 19.4% decline in consumer spending, driven primarily by a reduction in average cart value and, to a lesser extent, a decline in purchase frequency. Consumers also purchase fewer distinct products, shift to lower-priced items, and reduce their share of spending on popular products. We identify two mechanisms underlying these responses. First, the original threshold serves as a reference point, making the new threshold feel less attainable and weakening top-up behavior. Second, consumers with high search effort face disproportionate difficulty reaching the higher threshold and are more likely to reduce or abandon their basket. Managerial implications: To assess the implications for optimal policy design, we develop a stylized analytical model that captures both cost-and demand-side factors associated with increasing the CFS threshold. We find that it is optimal to increase the CFS threshold only when the average cart value is sufficiently close to the original threshold. This result aligns closely with our empirical findings and remains robust to extensions that incorporate consumer heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了提高免运费门槛对消费者行为的影响，发现将门槛从80美元提高到100美元会导致消费者支出下降19.4%，主要原因是平均购物车价值降低和购买频率下降。研究还发现最优的免运费门槛调整策略是当平均购物车价值接近原门槛时才应提高门槛。
AI.research_question: 提高有条件免运费（CFS）门槛如何影响消费者行为？在什么条件下提高CFS门槛对平台是最优的？
AI.motivation: 电商平台广泛使用有条件免运费政策来鼓励更高的购物车价值，但随着履约成本上升，平台越来越难以确定如何调整这些门槛。需要理解提高门槛对消费者行为的影响以及最优调整条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参考点理论（原门槛作为参考点影响消费者感知）、搜索成本理论（高搜索努力消费者面临更大困难）、行为经济学中的目标可达性理论
AI.method: 使用北美在线杂货平台的详细交易和点击流数据，采用双重差分法分析门槛从80美元提高到100美元的影响
AI.findings: 提高CFS门槛导致消费者支出下降19.4%，主要原因是平均购物车价值降低和购买频率下降。消费者购买更少的不同产品，转向低价商品，减少在热门产品上的支出份额。机制包括：原门槛作为参考点使新门槛显得更难达到，削弱了凑单行为；高搜索努力消费者更难达到更高门槛，更可能减少或放弃购物车。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）揭示了CFS门槛调整对消费者行为的复杂影响机制；2）整合了参考点理论和搜索成本理论来解释消费者反应；3）提供了分析平台最优门槛调整的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为平台提供了评估CFS门槛调整影响的实证依据；2）开发了考虑成本和需求因素的最优政策设计模型；3）建议平台仅在平均购物车价值接近原门槛时才提高门槛，这一发现对实际运营具有重要指导意义

title: To Disclose or not to Disclose? Reputational incentives and ESG Disclosure in Private Family Firms
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Accounting, China Europe International Business School - Accounting & Finance Department, , Bocconi University and Bocconi University

detail.title: To Disclose or not to Disclose? Reputational incentives and ESG Disclosure in Private Family Firms
detail.abstract: This study examines how reputation linked to family identity affects voluntary ESG disclosure in private family firms, focusing on eponymous firms-those named after their founders or controlling families. Drawing on legitimacy theory, we argue that when family and firm identities are closely aligned, ESG disclosure serves to protect and signal legitimacy to external stakeholders. Using a sample of 2,769 Italian private family firms from 2013 to 2021, we find that eponymous firms are significantly more likely to publish ESG reports. The effect is stronger when reputational exposure is higher, including cases of rarer surnames, greater press visibility, and more positive prior media sentiment. Eponymous firms also report more substantive ESG actions-particularly in social and environmental domains-and exhibit lower realized environmental impact, suggesting that disclosure reflects genuine engagement rather than symbolic reporting. Robustness tests address alternative governance, visibility, reporting standardization, and selection explanations. Overall, the evidence indicates that owner identity, reputation, and legitimacy concerns jointly shape voluntary ESG disclosure and sustainability outcomes in private family firms.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨家族身份声誉如何影响私营家族企业的自愿ESG披露，重点关注以创始人或控制家族命名的同名企业。研究发现，当家族与企业身份紧密关联时，同名企业更可能发布ESG报告，尤其是在声誉风险较高时，且这种披露反映了真实的可持续发展实践而非象征性报告。
AI.research_question: 家族身份声誉如何影响私营家族企业的自愿ESG披露？特别是，以创始人或控制家族命名的同名企业是否更倾向于进行ESG披露？
AI.motivation: 私营家族企业在全球经济中占据重要地位，但其ESG披露动机研究不足。家族身份与声誉的紧密联系可能影响企业披露行为，特别是当企业以家族命名时，这种身份关联可能增强企业通过ESG披露来维护合法性的动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合法性理论：当家族与企业身份紧密关联时，ESG披露作为保护和向外部利益相关者传递合法性的信号机制。
AI.method: 使用2013-2021年期间2,769家意大利私营家族企业的样本数据进行实证分析，检验同名企业（以创始人或控制家族命名）与ESG披露之间的关系，并考察声誉暴露（姓氏稀有度、媒体可见度、前期媒体情感）的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 同名企业显著更可能发布ESG报告；2. 当声誉暴露较高时（姓氏更稀有、媒体可见度更高、前期媒体情感更积极），这种效应更强；3. 同名企业报告更多实质性ESG行动（特别是社会和环境领域）；4. 同名企业表现出更低的环境影响，表明披露反映真实参与而非象征性报告。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将合法性理论应用于私营家族企业ESG披露研究；2. 揭示家族身份与企业身份关联对披露行为的影响机制；3. 提出声誉暴露作为重要调节变量；4. 区分实质性披露与象征性报告。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为家族企业管理者提供ESG披露决策参考；2. 帮助投资者理解家族企业ESG披露动机；3. 为政策制定者设计私营企业ESG披露框架提供依据；4. 促进家族企业通过实质性ESG实践提升长期价值。

title: From Ideal to Non-Ideal AI Ethics: Towards Adaptive Governance Through Checks and Balances

detail.title: From Ideal to Non-Ideal AI Ethics: Towards Adaptive Governance Through Checks and Balances

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The author is employed as a PhD researcher at Copenhagen Business School. This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Governance of AI is frequently articulated through high-level normative principles intended to guide diverse applications and jurisdictions. While such "ideal theoretical" approaches offer conceptual clarity, their reliance on abstraction can obscure the institutional, political, and technological conditions under which AI systems are developed and deployed. This risks a detachment between principles and practice, resulting in vague guidance and limited compliance. In contrast, the non-ideal approach defended here emphasizes feasibility, context sensitivity, empirical grounding, and the problem of non-compliance, proposing a model of governance rooted in the diverse realities of AI development and deployment. Here, governance is conceived as an institutional system of mutual constraints, in which principles, sectoral integration, and stakeholder engagement function as checks on one another. However, such a non-ideal approach faces challenges arising from uncertainty within a rapidly evolving socio-technical landscape. The proposed solution entails an adaptive framework operating through a polycentric system of checks and balances, enabling the real-time identification of emerging risks and techno-moral shifts amid the rapid deployment of generative and frontier AI systems. In doing so, this framework both generates epistemically relevant moral data and functions as a dynamic governance mechanism capable of co-evolving with changing institutional, technological, and moral conditions across diverse contexts of AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了AI治理中依赖高层级规范原则的"理想理论"方法，提出了一种基于可行性、情境敏感性和经验基础的"非理想"治理方法，强调通过多元中心的制衡系统实现适应性治理框架。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既能应对AI系统快速发展的技术复杂性，又能有效连接治理原则与实践的适应性AI治理框架？
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理主要依赖高层级规范原则，但这些"理想理论"方法因过度抽象而与实际开发部署的现实条件脱节，导致指导模糊、合规有限，需要更接地气的治理方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非理想理论方法（强调可行性、情境敏感性、经验基础）、多元中心治理理论、适应性治理框架、制度约束系统理论。
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建，通过理论对比（理想vs非理想方法）和制度设计，提出适应性治理模型。
AI.findings: 非理想治理方法通过多元中心的制衡系统能够实时识别新兴风险和道德技术转变，生成具有认识论意义的道德数据，并作为动态治理机制与不断变化的制度、技术和道德条件共同演化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将非理想理论方法系统应用于AI治理领域；2）提出制度约束系统的治理概念；3）建立适应性治理框架的理论基础；4）强调治理原则、部门整合和利益相关者参与的相互制衡机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供可行的AI治理实施框架；2）促进原则与实践的更好连接；3）增强治理系统对快速技术变化的适应性；4）支持跨不同AI部署情境的灵活治理。

title: Reflexive Valuation Operator Theory (RVOT): A Unified Framework for Endogenous Pricing, Return Predictability, and Intermediary-Driven Equilibrium
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: Reflexive Valuation Operator Theory (RVOT): A Unified Framework for Endogenous Pricing, Return Predictability, and Intermediary-Driven Equilibrium
detail.abstract: We develop Reflexive Valuation Operator Theory (RVOT), a framework in which asset prices are fixed points of a valuation operator that augments the classical stochastic discount factor (SDF) recursion with a pressure distortion driven by intermediary balance-sheet constraints and institutional flows. The central design choice-anchoring the distortion to an exogenous benchmark P ⋆ t rather than the endogenous price-delivers exact cancellation in the contraction comparison, yielding a sharp payout-discipline condition for equilibrium existence and uniqueness. The empirically operative result is localized: uniqueness holds on any bounded valuation set M K with θ K > 0; as θ K ↓ 0 the model transitions from uniqueness to multiplicity to rational bubble feasibility, with the non-contractive boundary characterized by Schauder's theorem. The theory delivers five main results beyond existence: a closed-form return decomposition into fundamental, SDF, payout, and pressure channels; a predictability threshold linking pressure mean reversion to long-horizon R 2 ; a rational bubble characterization via an augmented transversality condition; cross-asset spillover dynamics governed by a pressure Jacobian; and a nonlinear BSDE continuous-time limit with closed-form pricing PDE. We further provide a second-order welfare wedge from pressure-induced pecuniary externalities, and GMM and sieve estimators with asymptotic theory and a replicable empirical blueprint for U.S. equity data. Classical SDF pricing is nested as the zero-pressure special case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反射估值算子理论（RVOT），将中介机构资产负债表约束和机构资金流驱动的压力扭曲纳入经典随机贴现因子递归，建立了资产价格存在性和唯一性的新框架。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑中介机构约束和机构资金流压力的情况下，建立资产定价的一般均衡理论框架，并解决存在性、唯一性及理性泡沫等问题？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价理论忽略中介机构资产负债表约束和机构资金流对价格的影响，无法解释市场中的多重均衡、理性泡沫等现象，需要新的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反射估值算子理论（RVOT），将经典随机贴现因子（SDF）递归扩展为包含压力扭曲的估值算子，锚定于外生基准而非内生价格，确保收缩性比较中的精确抵消。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建RVOT框架，使用不动点理论、Schauder定理等数学工具分析存在性和唯一性；实证方法：提供GMM和筛估计量，以及美国股票数据的可复制实证蓝图。
AI.findings: 1）存在性和唯一性条件：在有限估值集上存在唯一均衡；2）收益分解：可分解为基础、SDF、支付和压力四个渠道；3）理性泡沫：通过扩展横截条件刻画；4）跨资产溢出：由压力雅可比矩阵控制；5）连续时间极限：非线性BSDE和闭式定价PDE。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立RVOT统一框架；2）提供存在性和唯一性的严格条件；3）提出收益分解新方法；4）刻画理性泡沫形成机制；5）分析跨资产溢出效应；6）推导连续时间极限；7）包含经典SDF定价为零压力特例。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供可操作的实证估计方法；2）识别压力诱导的福利楔；3）为监管政策提供理论依据；4）帮助投资者理解市场动态；5）为风险管理提供新视角。

title: Entry Mode, Risk Governance Intensity, and Project Failure: Evidence from Multinational Construction Firms
affiliations: University of Waterloo - School of Planning, University of Waterloo - School of Planning, University of Waterloo - School of Planning and University of Waterloo - School of Planning

detail.title: Entry Mode, Risk Governance Intensity, and Project Failure: Evidence from Multinational Construction Firms
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how entry mode and risk governance intensity jointly influence project failure in multinational construction firms. Using 214 overseas projects from 21 firms across 19 host countries between 2011 and 2022, we classify entry modes into wholly owned subsidiaries, joint ventures, and consortium-based contracts. A hierarchical panel-survival framework is developed to model the time to project failure, defined as severe cost overruns above 30%, contract termination, or unresolved payment disputes. Governance intensity is measured using a composite index that captures frequency of on-site risk reviews, budget monitoring, and compliance audits. The results show that joint ventures reduce project failure hazard by 17.4% relative to wholly owned subsidiaries, but only when governance intensity is above the sample median. For projects with weak governance, joint ventures display a 12.8% higher hazard due to coordination and accountability issues. Consortium-based contracts show the highest baseline hazard but experience a 21.3% reduction when coupled with integrated risk-compliance dashboards. Sensitivity analyses with shared frailty models and alternative failure thresholds confirm the robustness of the estimates. The study provides granular evidence on how multinational firms can align entry mode choices with risk governance strategies to reduce project failure in cross-border environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了进入模式与风险治理强度如何共同影响跨国建筑企业的项目失败。基于2011-2022年间21家企业在19个东道国的214个海外项目数据，发现合资企业相对于全资子公司能降低17.4%的项目失败风险，但仅在治理强度高于中位数时有效。治理薄弱时，合资企业反而增加12.8%的风险。联合体合同风险最高，但结合综合风险合规仪表板可降低21.3%的风险。
AI.research_question: 进入模式和风险治理强度如何共同影响跨国建筑企业的项目失败？
AI.motivation: 跨国建筑企业在海外项目中面临高失败率，现有研究多单独考察进入模式或治理机制的影响，缺乏对两者交互作用的实证分析，难以提供有效的管理指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际商务理论（进入模式选择）和风险管理理论（治理机制），构建了进入模式与风险治理强度的交互作用框架，解释不同治理环境下进入模式对项目失败的影响差异。
AI.method: 采用分层面板生存分析框架，分析214个海外项目数据（2011-2022年）。进入模式分为全资子公司、合资企业和联合体合同。治理强度通过现场风险审查频率、预算监控和合规审计的复合指数衡量。项目失败定义为成本超支30%以上、合同终止或未解决的付款纠纷。
AI.findings: 1. 合资企业相对于全资子公司能降低17.4%的项目失败风险，但仅在治理强度高于样本中位数时有效；2. 治理薄弱时，合资企业反而增加12.8%的风险；3. 联合体合同风险最高，但结合综合风险合规仪表板可降低21.3%的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合国际商务和风险管理理论，提出进入模式与治理强度的交互作用框架；2. 揭示了治理强度作为边界条件的重要性；3. 为跨国项目风险管理提供了更精细的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为跨国建筑企业提供了进入模式与治理策略匹配的具体指导；2. 建议合资企业必须配合高强度治理；3. 推荐联合体合同采用综合风险合规仪表板；4. 提供了可操作的治理强度测量指标。

title: Spatial Optimization for Medication for Opioid use Disorder Facilities: Modeling Treatment Expansion
affiliations: University of Alabama and University of Alabama

detail.title: Spatial Optimization for Medication for Opioid use Disorder Facilities: Modeling Treatment Expansion
detail.abstract: Opioid and polydrug overdose deaths have increased drastically in the US, largely driven by the COVID-19 pandemic and the increasing toxicity of the drug supply. Medication for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD) with FDA approved methadone or buprenorphine is considered the most effective treatment for opioid use disorder. However, there is a scarcity of MOUD provider availability in the US. Recent research has found that a staggering 97% of buprenorphine providers across community types in the US are at their patient capacity limit. This work operationalizes location science in the context of opioid treatment resource allocation by applying the Maximum Covering Location Problem (MCLP) to optimize coverage of scarce MOUD resources, using Alabama as a case study. Further, to ensure the allocation of MOUD resources across urban, suburban, and rural community types, a novel variation of the Multiple Type-MCLP optimization problem is presented to incorporate facility types. This work provides a road map to begin improving access to buprenorphine via data-driven intervention planning. Further, research findings demonstrate a comparable amount of coverage can be achieved when facilities are strategically distributed outside of urban areas. This result is important given that suburban and rural communities have experienced a disproportionate burden of opioid overdoses, while these same communities predominantly have low or no accessibility to treatment resources. These coordinated treatment allocation efforts can contribute to omitting treatment availability as an overarching constraint in curbing the opioid overdose epidemic.

AI.tldr: 本研究应用最大覆盖选址问题（MCLP）优化阿片类药物使用障碍治疗资源分配，以阿拉巴马州为例，提出考虑城乡社区类型的新型多类型MCLP模型，旨在提高丁丙诺啡治疗可及性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过优化选址策略，在资源有限的情况下最大化阿片类药物使用障碍治疗（特别是丁丙诺啡）的覆盖范围，同时确保城乡社区间的公平分配？
AI.motivation: 美国阿片类药物和多药物过量死亡急剧增加，而FDA批准的丁丙诺啡等药物治疗资源严重不足，97%的提供者已达患者容量上限，且城乡社区间治疗资源分配不均，农村和郊区社区负担重但可及性低。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最大覆盖选址问题（MCLP）理论框架，以及作者提出的新型多类型MCLP优化问题，该模型考虑了不同社区类型（城市、郊区、农村）的设施类型分配。
AI.method: 以阿拉巴马州为案例研究，应用MCLP优化稀缺治疗资源分配，并开发多类型MCLP变体模型，确保资源在不同社区类型间的均衡分配。
AI.findings: 研究发现，通过战略性地在城市以外地区分布设施，可以实现相当的覆盖范围；这对负担重但治疗资源可及性低的郊区和农村社区尤为重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 将选址科学应用于阿片类治疗资源分配领域，提出了考虑社区类型的新型多类型MCLP优化模型，扩展了传统选址理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为通过数据驱动的干预规划提高丁丙诺啡可及性提供了路线图，证明战略性的城乡资源分配可实现同等覆盖效果，有助于缓解治疗可及性对遏制阿片类药物过量流行的制约。

title: Managerial Competence in International Projects in Medicine, Mental Health, and Developmental Neuropsychology: A Consensus-Assisted Literature Review
affiliations: Bogomolets National Medical University and Pylyp Orlyk International Classical University

detail.title: Managerial Competence in International Projects in Medicine, Mental Health, and Developmental Neuropsychology: A Consensus-Assisted Literature Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is theoretical in nature and does not involve human participants or personal data. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Managerial competence in international projects spanning medicine, mental health, developmental neuropsychology, and adjacent pharmaceutical systems has become a decisive determinant of implementation quality, ethical robustness, and sustainability. The contemporary project environment is defined by intensified interdisciplinarity, expanded digital infrastructures, growing dependence on distributed teams, and increasing scrutiny of governance, data quality, and mental health in the workplace. Against this background, the present review synthesises literature on the competence profile required of managers coordinating complex international initiatives across health-related domains. The review was conducted using an AI-assisted search workflow via Consensus, followed by staged screening and relevance-based selection. A broad search corpus (n = 1000 identified records) was reduced through screening (n = 797), eligibility assessment (n = 280), and final inclusion of the 20 most relevant publications. The included works comprise conceptual and empirical studies, scoping reviews, mapping reviews, practice-oriented reviews, and conference abstracts, with evidence drawn not only from health and mental health settings but also from adjacent project-intensive sectors where managerial mental health and governance have been modelled in detail. The synthesis identifies a multi-domain competence architecture comprising foundational (scientific literacy, ethics, diversity and interculturality, systems thinking, reflective practice), functional (assessment, intervention coordination, consultation, advocacy), and operational-strategic (governance, stakeholder alignment, uncertainty management, digital/AI literacy, quality and risk management, communication architecture, and organisational climate stewardship) components. The findings further indicate that managerial competence is not reducible to generic project management skills; rather, it is an integrative capacity to govern interfaces across disciplinary, cultural, regulatory, technological, and psychosocial domains. Digital transformation and AI/LLM uptake are altering competence requirements, but the literature simultaneously highlights persistent risks associated with data governance, over-reliance on automated tools, and insufficient human-centred design. Major barriers include the absence of internationally harmonised competence standards, uneven evidence across subfields (especially developmental neuropsychology management and digital ethics implementation), and the under-theorisation of burnout prevention for project leaders in large, matrixed programmes. The article concludes by proposing an integrated competence framework and a set of research priorities for standard-setting, measurement development, and intervention studies. This synthesis is designed for Scopus-oriented scholarly use and may serve as a conceptual foundation for subsequent empirical and psychometric studies of managerial readiness in international health projects.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文通过AI辅助文献搜索，分析了国际健康项目管理者的能力架构，提出了包含基础、功能、运营战略三个维度的能力模型，并指出数字转型对能力要求的影响及现存障碍。
AI.research_question: 在国际健康项目中，管理者需要具备什么样的能力架构来确保实施质量、伦理稳健性和可持续性？
AI.motivation: 当代项目管理环境日益复杂，涉及跨学科性增强、数字基础设施扩展、分布式团队依赖增加，以及对治理、数据质量和职场心理健康的更高要求，需要明确管理者在协调复杂国际健康项目中的能力要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能力架构理论，整合项目管理、跨文化管理、数字素养、伦理治理等多领域理论，构建综合性的管理者能力模型。
AI.method: 采用AI辅助文献搜索工作流程（通过Consensus平台），进行分阶段筛选和基于相关性的选择。从1000篇文献中经过筛选（797篇）、资格评估（280篇），最终纳入20篇最相关出版物，包括概念性和实证研究、范围综述、实践导向综述等。
AI.findings: 识别出多领域能力架构：基础能力（科学素养、伦理、多元文化、系统思维、反思实践）、功能能力（评估、干预协调、咨询、倡导）、运营战略能力（治理、利益相关者协调、不确定性管理、数字/AI素养、质量与风险管理、沟通架构、组织氛围管理）。管理者能力不能简化为通用项目管理技能，而是跨学科、文化、监管、技术和心理社会领域接口的综合治理能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国际健康项目管理者的综合能力框架，丰富了项目管理理论在健康领域的应用，为后续实证和心理测量研究提供了概念基础，填补了该领域理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织选拔和培养国际健康项目管理者提供了能力标准参考，帮助识别数字转型对能力要求的变化，指出了能力发展中的障碍（如缺乏国际统一标准、证据分布不均等），并提出了研究优先事项。

title: Synthetic Weight of Evidence
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Synthetic Weight of Evidence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I was employed during part of the research by Agora Data and the other part by Fancy Quant LLC.
declarations.funderStatement: Agora Data was employing me during a portion of the research and was paying me a salary. Fancy Quant LLC was the employer for the second half of the research.

detail.abstract: In financial credit modeling it is common to transform variables from their raw state into weight of evidence (WOE) transformations for binary problems such as probability modeling. One advantage of using WOE is that it handles missing value, outliers, and categorical variables. It also reduces noise and provides an intuitive way of comparing the variables' predictive power as well as producing directional relationships. In this paper the examples and explanations will be from a finance credit modeling perspective. Instead of the common terms of "event" and "nonevent" for modeling a binary outcome, the term "bad" will be used for the event of a loan default and the term "good" will be used for non-defaulted loan. WOE is used in many industries however this paper is using finance to create a more tangible example.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在金融信用建模中，使用证据权重（WOE）转换变量来处理缺失值、异常值和分类变量，并提升模型预测能力的方法。
AI.research_question: 在金融信用建模中，如何有效使用证据权重（WOE）转换来处理原始变量，以改善二元概率模型的性能？
AI.motivation: 金融信用建模中，原始变量常存在缺失值、异常值和分类变量等问题，WOE转换能有效处理这些问题，同时提供直观的变量预测能力比较和方向性关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 证据权重（WOE）理论框架，包括WOE的计算方法、在二元分类问题中的应用原理，以及其在处理数据质量问题上的理论优势。
AI.method: 使用金融信用建模案例研究，以贷款违约（"bad"）和非违约（"good"）作为二元结果，展示WOE转换的具体应用过程和效果。
AI.findings: WOE转换能有效处理缺失值、异常值和分类变量，减少噪声，提供变量预测能力的直观比较，并建立方向性关系，特别适用于金融信用风险评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了WOE在金融信用建模中的理论应用，明确了其在处理特定金融数据问题上的理论优势，为二元概率模型提供了更稳健的变量预处理方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者提供了具体的WOE应用案例和操作指南，帮助改进信用评分模型的构建过程，提升模型在实际风险评估中的准确性和可解释性。

title: Selling the Haggle
affiliations: , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management,  and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Selling the Haggle
detail.abstract: Price haggling is widely viewed as a source of friction in retail markets: customers bear bargaining costs, and firms face operational complexity. This logic has motivated some firms to adopt fixed pricing. We show that in markets organized around personal selling, eliminating negotiation can backfire. Using lead and transaction data from a major automaker in China that introduced a one-price policy for one model while retaining negotiation for all others at the same dealerships, we find that the policy reduced sales of the targeted model and shifted demand toward models where negotiation remained available. Notably, although the fixed price was below the prior average negotiated price at most dealerships, the pattern persists within this subgroup. We argue that the process of negotiation serves as an effective deal closing tool for the salesperson. When this instrument is removed for one product, salespeople become less equipped to convert leads into sales and may redirect customers toward products for which negotiation remains available. Consistent with this mechanism, demand switching is larger among salespeople who relied more heavily on price discussion prior to the policy. These findings suggest that, beyond negotiation outcomes external to the firm (such as customer disutility, price dispersion, or surplus extraction), an internal organizational factor also matters when evaluating pricing regimes: the salesforce, whose ability to haggle often serves as the instrument that closes the deal.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在个人销售主导的市场中，取消价格谈判反而会降低销量，因为谈判过程是销售人员促成交易的重要工具。
AI.research_question: 在个人销售主导的零售市场中，取消价格谈判（采用固定价格政策）会对销售业绩产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为价格谈判会增加交易摩擦（客户承担议价成本，企业面临运营复杂性），因此一些企业转向固定定价。但作者质疑在个人销售环境中这种逻辑是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于销售心理学和谈判理论，强调谈判过程作为交易促成工具的重要性，而非仅仅关注谈判结果（如价格分散、消费者剩余等）。
AI.method: 利用中国某大型汽车制造商的自然实验数据：对一款车型实施一价政策（固定价格），而同一经销商的其他车型仍保留议价，通过对比分析销售线索和交易数据。
AI.findings: 1. 一价政策降低了目标车型的销量；2. 需求转向仍可议价的车型；3. 即使固定价格低于之前平均议价价格，该模式依然存在；4. 需求转移效应在依赖价格讨论的销售人员中更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统关于议价摩擦的观点，提出内部组织因素（销售人员议价能力作为交易促成工具）在评估定价机制时的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在个人销售环境中制定定价策略提供新视角：不应仅考虑外部因素（客户体验、价格分散），还需考虑销售人员如何利用议价作为销售工具。

title: The GOD Formula: Virtue and Equity as Infinite Balancers of Societal Outcomes
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The GOD Formula: Virtue and Equity as Infinite Balancers of Societal Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Studying the past in the efforts to build a stronger future.
declarations.funderStatement: Self

detail.abstract: The GOD Formula presents a theoretical model of societal evolution wherein future outcomes emerge as exponential functions of human and technological potential, balanced by moral and equitable stabilizers. The core equation proposes: This model posits that societal collapse occurs not from technological advancement itself, but from imbalances in moral frameworks (Virtue) and systemic fairness (Equity). Empirical validation draws from post-2001 U.S. religious decline patterns, deaths of despair epidemiology, and historical empire collapse studies. Data show Christian identi cation declined from 78% (2007) to 62% (2023-24), while deaths of despair increased 2.5-fold from 1999 to 2021, reaching fth leading cause of death status[1][2]. Historical analysis reveals inequality patterns preceding major empire collapses, with Gini coe cients correlating with political instability[3]. The formula implies that advancing technology requires proportional scaling of virtue-based ethics and equity-based rights protections to prevent systemic failure.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个社会演化的理论模型（GOD公式），认为未来社会结果是人类与技术潜能的指数函数，受道德和公平稳定器的平衡。社会崩溃源于道德框架和系统公平性的失衡，而非技术进步本身。
AI.research_question: 社会演化如何通过人类与技术潜能的指数函数关系进行描述？社会崩溃的根本原因是什么？如何平衡技术进步与道德伦理、公平性以防止系统性失败？
AI.motivation: 观察到当代社会面临宗教认同下降、绝望死亡增加、不平等加剧等趋势，这些现象与历史上的帝国崩溃模式相似。需要建立一个理论框架来解释社会演化规律，并为预防系统性失败提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: GOD公式理论模型：社会演化是Human（人类）和Technology（技术）潜能的指数函数，由Virtue（道德）和Equity（公平）作为稳定器平衡。社会崩溃理论：崩溃源于道德框架和系统公平性的失衡。
AI.method: 1. 实证验证：分析2001年后美国宗教衰退模式（基督教认同从78%降至62%）；2. 流行病学研究：绝望死亡从1999年到2021年增加2.5倍；3. 历史分析：帝国崩溃前的不平等模式，基尼系数与政治不稳定相关性。
AI.findings: 1. 宗教认同显著下降（2007年78% → 2023-24年62%）；2. 绝望死亡大幅增加（2.5倍），成为第五大死因；3. 历史帝国崩溃前存在不平等模式，基尼系数与政治不稳定相关；4. 技术进步需要道德伦理和公平权利保护的相应扩展。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了社会演化的GOD公式理论模型；2. 建立了技术进步与道德伦理、公平性的平衡框架；3. 解释了社会崩溃的根本机制；4. 为理解社会演化提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了预防社会崩溃的框架；2. 强调了技术进步中道德伦理和公平性的重要性；3. 提供了基于历史模式和当代趋势的预警指标；4. 为社会治理和可持续发展提供了实践指导。

title: Developmental Uncertainty: When Coordination Demands Enable Occupational Mobility Across Status Boundaries
affiliations: University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) - College of Engineering and

detail.title: Developmental Uncertainty: When Coordination Demands Enable Occupational Mobility Across Status Boundaries
detail.abstract: Organizations struggle to develop professional talent while workers without credentials struggle to obtain it-a structural mismatch with consequences for firms, workers, and the economy. Nonprofessionals increasingly work alongside professionals in technology development, but prior work is pessimistic about implications for skill development: status boundaries are defended, knowledge is hoarded, and inclusion efforts tend toward extraction rather than development. We theorize a striking exception. In a three-year field study of an AI-enabled robotics vendor, nonprofessional "drivers" who joined during high-uncertainty phases built substantial technical skills-76% advanced to professional roles, with 19% moving into positions typically requiring credentials they lacked. Workers who joined later, with identical job design, had far more limited development. Drawing on contingency theory, we identify developmental uncertainty: uncertainty drives cross-boundary coordination that enables skill transfer and occupational mobility across status boundaries. As uncertainty is consumed and encoded into automation, coordination demands decline, boundaries harden, and the developmental window closes. We draw on 145 interviews, 17 months of observation, and 29 million records of human-robot interaction to document this process. The findings offer rare leverage on the talent mismatch problem-but only for those who recognize the window while it remains open.

AI.tldr: 研究发现：在AI机器人公司中，非专业"司机"在高不确定性阶段加入能获得显著技术技能发展，76%晋升到专业岗位，19%进入通常需要证书的职位。后期加入者发展有限，因为不确定性被自动化编码后，协调需求下降，发展窗口关闭。
AI.research_question: 在技术开发中，非专业人士如何能够跨越地位边界获得技能发展？什么条件促进了这种发展？
AI.motivation: 组织难以培养专业人才，而无证书工人难以获得技能发展——这种结构性不匹配对企业、工人和经济都有影响。先前研究对非专业人士与专业人士共同工作的技能发展前景持悲观态度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权变理论，特别是发展性不确定性概念：不确定性驱动跨边界协调，促进技能转移和职业流动。
AI.method: 为期三年的实地研究，包括145次访谈、17个月观察和2900万条人机交互记录，研究一家AI机器人供应商。
AI.findings: 在高不确定性阶段加入的非专业"司机"中，76%晋升到专业岗位，19%进入通常需要证书的职位。后期加入者发展有限。不确定性被自动化编码后，协调需求下降，边界固化，发展窗口关闭。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"发展性不确定性"概念，解释了不确定性如何促进跨地位边界的技能转移和职业流动，挑战了先前对非专业人士技能发展的悲观观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了解决人才不匹配问题的新视角：在高不确定性阶段为非专业人士创造发展机会，但需要识别并把握发展窗口期。

title: Standardizing Laboratory Data for Interoperability: Challenges and Lessons Learned from LOINC Implementation in Singapore
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Standardizing Laboratory Data for Interoperability: Challenges and Lessons Learned from LOINC Implementation in Singapore
detail.abstract: Background: Standardization of laboratory test data is crucial for ensuring interoperability, clinical decision support and allows comparability of results across systems or over time. In Singapore, the segregation of healthcare clusters created challenges for national data integration due to diverse healthcare information systems across different clusters. In line with a national directive emphasizing interoperability, Synapxe undertook the implementation of Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC) to standardize laboratory test data across multiple Public Healthcare Institutions (PHIs) in Singapore. Methods: A phased implementation approach was adopted, with individual PHIs implementing separate deployments rather than a coordinated national rollout. Mapping was performed collaboratively by laboratory medical technologists, informatics specialists, and consulting clinicians to ensure clinical and operational accuracy. Training sessions were conducted, emphasizing accurate coding and maintenance of data quality. Laboratory data was collected from 14 PHIs and mapped systematically. The LOINC-mapped data was integrated successfully into healthcare systems, and validation activities ensured all existing data flows remained unaffected. Results: As of March 2025, all 14 PHIs are LOINC-live with a collective 90.1% of laboratory tests mapped. Key challenges included limited human resources due to competing demands from the COVID-19 pandemic response and concurrent EMR system upgrades, organizational resistance and knowledge gaps among laboratory and informatics staff, and technical complexities in laboratory-to-electronic health record interfacing. To address these challenges, targeted interventions such as deployment of semi-automated tools, proactive stakeholder communication, and interdisciplinary training were employed. Some lessons learned from the implementation journey included the importance of early stakeholder engagement for establishment of clear roles and pre-emptive data quality checks. Conclusion: LOINC implementation in Singapore led to improved data consistency, regulatory compliance, and readiness for secondary uses such as clinical analytics and disease surveillance. The experiences and lessons outlined in this paper provide valuable insights for healthcare institutions embarking on similar laboratory data standardization initiatives.

AI.tldr: 新加坡通过分阶段实施LOINC标准，成功将14家公立医疗机构的实验室测试数据标准化，覆盖率达90.1%，提升了数据一致性、监管合规性，并为临床分析和疾病监测等二次使用做好准备。
AI.research_question: 新加坡如何成功实施LOINC标准来标准化跨多个公立医疗机构的实验室测试数据？
AI.motivation: 新加坡医疗集群的分离导致全国数据整合面临挑战，不同集群的医疗信息系统存在差异，需要遵循国家互操作性指令实现实验室数据的标准化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实验室数据标准化理论、医疗信息互操作性理论、组织变革管理理论。
AI.method: 采用分阶段实施方法，各医疗机构独立部署而非协调全国推广；实验室医学技术人员、信息学专家和临床医生协作进行映射；开展培训确保准确编码和数据质量维护；从14家医疗机构收集数据并系统映射；成功整合到医疗系统中并进行验证。
AI.findings: 截至2025年3月，所有14家医疗机构均已实施LOINC，实验室测试映射率达90.1%；主要挑战包括COVID-19疫情应对和EMR系统升级导致的人力资源限制、组织阻力和知识差距、实验室到电子健康记录接口的技术复杂性；通过半自动化工具、主动利益相关者沟通和跨学科培训等针对性干预措施应对挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为医疗数据标准化实施提供了分阶段方法的实证支持；强调了跨学科协作在医疗信息标准化中的重要性；验证了组织变革管理理论在医疗技术实施中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了LOINC实施的具体操作指南；识别了实施过程中的关键挑战和应对策略；为其他医疗机构进行类似数据标准化项目提供了经验教训；建立了可复制的实施框架。

title: Design and Implementation of an Intelligent Mineral Prospecting System Integrating Large Language Models: GoldMiner-AI
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) and Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU)

detail.title: Design and Implementation of an Intelligent Mineral Prospecting System Integrating Large Language Models: GoldMiner-AI
detail.abstract: Current intelligent mineral prospecting faces systemic challenges: fragmented data sources, disconnected analytical workflows, poorly organized knowledge, and a lack of automated, reproducible, and traceable processes at the system level. To overcome these limitations, we present GoldMiner-AI, an end-to-end intelligent system engineered for mineral exploration tasks. The system leverages a RuoYi-Cloud-Plus microservice architecture and a collaborative multi-database framework (PostGIS, Neo4j, Milvus, MySQL) to unify the management of multi-source, heterogeneous geoscientific data spanning geological maps, geochemical and geophysical surveys, drilling logs, field observations, and textual reports. Its intelligent core integrates two key components: the KAR-Graph anomaly identification framework and the deep learning model for multi-source feature fusion. Coupled with a mineral-systems knowledge graph and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), this architecture supports a domain-tailored large language model (LLM). This design establishes a closed-loop intelligent workflow that integrates anomaly detection, target delineation, knowledge-aided reasoning, and interactive Q&A. Validation experiments in representative ore districts (Youjiang Basin and southern Qin-Hang metallogenic belt) demonstrate that: (1) It effectively identifies Carlin-type gold-related Au-As-Sb-Hg anomalous assemblages and extracts diagnostic geochemical fingerprints of ore-forming processes; (2) Through multi-source data fusion, it accurately predicts the spatial distribution of Pb-Zn mineralization zones; and (3) The domain-specific LLM mitigates the “hallucination” common in general-purpose models, significantly improving the accuracy of geoscientific knowledge retrieval and Q&A. Collectively, GoldMiner-AI provides a reproducible, scalable, and production-ready platform that advances mineral exploration toward fully intelligent and systematic workflows.

AI.tldr: GoldMiner-AI是一个端到端的智能矿产勘查系统，通过微服务架构和多数据库框架整合多源异构地学数据，结合异常识别框架、深度学习模型和领域知识图谱，构建了闭环智能工作流，在典型矿区验证中有效识别异常组合、预测矿化分布并提升地学知识检索准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个端到端的智能矿产勘查系统，以解决当前智能矿产勘查面临的系统性挑战，包括数据碎片化、工作流割裂、知识组织混乱以及缺乏自动化、可重复、可追溯的系统级流程？
AI.motivation: 当前智能矿产勘查面临系统性挑战：数据源碎片化、分析工作流割裂、知识组织混乱、缺乏自动化、可重复和可追溯的系统级流程。这些限制阻碍了矿产勘查向全智能化和系统化工作流的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 微服务架构理论（RuoYi-Cloud-Plus）
2. 多数据库协同框架（PostGIS、Neo4j、Milvus、MySQL）
3. KAR-Graph异常识别框架
4. 多源特征融合的深度学习模型
5. 矿物系统知识图谱
6. 检索增强生成（RAG）技术
7. 领域定制大语言模型（LLM）
AI.method:
1. 系统架构设计：采用RuoYi-Cloud-Plus微服务架构和多数据库协同框架

AI.findings:

2. 通过多源数据融合，准确预测Pb-Zn矿化带的空间分布
3. 领域特定LLM显著缓解通用模型的"幻觉"问题，大幅提升地学知识检索和问答的准确性

2. 发展了KAR-Graph异常识别框架与多源特征融合深度学习模型相结合的智能分析方法

4. 建立了从异常检测、目标圈定到知识辅助推理和交互问答的闭环智能工作流理论

2. 解决了实际勘查中的数据碎片化、工作流割裂等实际问题
