title: Strengthening Financial Security of the U.S. Banking Sector: Regulatory Tools and Practical Risk Mitigation Strategies

detail.title: Strengthening Financial Security of the U.S. Banking Sector: Regulatory Tools and Practical Risk Mitigation Strategies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants or personal data were involved in this research. Ethical approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This working paper evaluates the financial security of the U.S. banking sector through an indicator-based analytical framework that integrates capital adequacy, liquidity resilience, asset quality, and supervisory effectiveness. Drawing on supervisory reports from the Federal Reserve, FDIC risk reviews, and international financial stability assessments, the study examines recent structural developments in banking sector resilience.

The paper introduces a Composite Financial Security Effectiveness Index (CFSI) designed to measure the effectiveness of regulatory tools in mitigating systemic risks. The results indicate that while the U.S. banking system remains structurally resilient — with capital buffers significantly exceeding Basel III minimum requirements and liquidity indicators remaining strong — emerging vulnerabilities related to funding structure shifts, interest-rate exposure, and non-bank financial interconnections require continued supervisory attention.

The proposed framework offers a practical approach for evaluating regulatory effectiveness and may be applied in comparative financial stability assessments across banking systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建综合金融安全有效性指数(CFSI)，评估美国银行业金融安全状况，发现尽管资本充足率和流动性指标强劲，但融资结构转变、利率风险和非银行金融互联等新兴脆弱性仍需监管关注。
AI.research_question: 如何评估美国银行业金融安全状况？监管工具在缓解系统性风险方面的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 需要系统评估美国银行业金融安全状况，识别结构性发展中的脆弱性，为监管政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资本充足性、流动性韧性、资产质量和监管有效性四个维度的指标分析框架，构建综合金融安全有效性指数(CFSI)。
AI.method: 基于美联储监管报告、FDIC风险评估和国际金融稳定评估的监管数据，采用指标分析法构建CFSI指数，评估监管工具有效性。
AI.findings: 美国银行体系结构韧性较强：资本缓冲显著超过巴塞尔III最低要求，流动性指标保持强劲；但存在融资结构转变、利率风险暴露和非银行金融互联等新兴脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出综合金融安全有效性指数(CFSI)框架，为评估监管有效性提供理论工具；将系统性风险缓解与监管工具有效性相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供评估银行业金融安全的实用框架；识别需要持续关注的新兴脆弱性；可用于跨银行体系的比较金融稳定评估。

title: Local Prosecutors and Public Health
affiliations: Vanderbilt University and Wellesley College

detail.title: Local Prosecutors and Public Health
detail.abstract: Legal scholars argue that local prosecutors may be the most powerful actors in the criminal justice system, yet there is a limited understanding of how different prosecutorial approaches shape community level outcomes. This paper investigates the causal relationship between approaches taken by local criminal prosecutors—also called district attorneys—and community-level mortality rates. We leverage plausibly exogenous variation in prosecutorial approaches generated by closely contested partisan prosecutor elections, a context in which Republican prosecutorial candidates are commonly characterized as "tougher on crime." Using data from hundreds of closely contested partisan elections from 2010 to 2019 and a vote share regression discontinuity design, we find that narrow election of a Republican prosecutor reduces all-cause mortality rates among young men ages 20 to 29 by 6.6%. This decline is driven predominantly by reductions in firearm-related deaths, including a large reduction in firearm homicide among Black men and a smaller reduction in firearm suicides and accidents primarily among White men. Mechanism analyses indicate that increased prison-based incapacitation explains about one third of the effect among Black men and none of the effect among White men. Instead, the primary channel appears to be substantial increases in criminal conviction rates across racial groups and crime types, which then reduce firearm access through legal restrictions on gun ownership for the convicted.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在势均力敌的党派检察官选举中，共和党检察官的当选会使20-29岁年轻男性的全因死亡率降低6.6%，主要原因是减少了枪支相关死亡，其中黑人男性枪击凶杀案大幅减少，白人男性枪击自杀和意外事故小幅减少。
AI.research_question: 地方检察官的不同起诉方式如何影响社区层面的死亡率？特别是共和党检察官（通常被认为"对犯罪更严厉"）的当选是否以及如何影响年轻男性的死亡率？
AI.motivation: 法律学者认为地方检察官可能是刑事司法系统中最有权力的角色，但人们对不同起诉方式如何影响社区层面结果的理解有限。需要实证研究检察官政策对公共健康结果（如死亡率）的因果影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于刑事司法威慑理论、监禁的失能效应理论，以及法律限制枪支获取对减少枪支暴力的理论框架。研究检察官政策通过刑事定罪和枪支限制影响死亡率的机制。
AI.method: 采用断点回归设计，利用2010-2019年间数百场势均力敌的党派检察官选举产生的准外生变异。比较共和党和民主党检察官在选举结果边缘差异对死亡率的影响。
AI.findings: 共和党检察官的当选使20-29岁年轻男性全因死亡率降低6.6%，主要由枪支相关死亡减少驱动：黑人男性枪击凶杀大幅减少，白人男性枪击自杀和意外事故小幅减少。监禁失能效应解释了黑人男性约三分之一的效应，但对白人男性无影响。主要机制是通过增加刑事定罪率，进而通过法律限制被定罪者的枪支获取权。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证检验了检察官政策对社区死亡率的因果影响，揭示了刑事司法政策通过枪支获取限制影响公共健康的新机制，为检察官权力与公共健康结果的关系提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为检察官选举和政策制定提供实证依据，显示"对犯罪更严厉"的政策可能通过减少枪支获取降低死亡率，特别是对年轻男性。为刑事司法改革和枪支暴力预防政策提供参考。

title: Structural Pricing Models for Corporate Bond Index Credit Spreads: Senior vs Subordinated
affiliations: Bar-Ilan University and Bar-Ilan University - Graduate School of Business Administration

detail.title: Structural Pricing Models for Corporate Bond Index Credit Spreads: Senior vs Subordinated

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We confirm that we do not have any personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced our study.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether incorporating subordinated-debt pricing improves the tracking of weekly changes in corporate bond-index credit spreads. We develop a contingent-claims framework that compares a senior-debt (Merton) specification with a subordinated-debt (Black-Cox) model using a zerocoupon pseudo-issuer whose assets replicate the S&P 500. The model is calibrated to each index's duration and leverage and employs four volatility inputs: historical, option-implied, ARIMA and ARIMAX forecasts. Out-ofsample results for 2019-2023 show that both models explain a large share of weekly spread variation. The subordinated model adds value particularly in investment-grade and broad indices when market volatility nears a critical threshold where junior debt valuation shifts from equity-like to debt-like sensitivity. However, the senior model remains the more reliable baseline in normal market conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在跟踪公司债券指数信用利差周度变化时，引入次级债定价是否能提升预测效果。通过构建或有债权框架，比较了仅考虑优先债的Merton模型和考虑次级债的Black-Cox模型。研究发现，在市场波动接近临界阈值时，次级债模型对投资级和宽基指数有额外价值，但在正常市场条件下，优先债模型仍是更可靠的基准。
AI.research_question: 在跟踪公司债券指数信用利差的周度变化时，引入次级债定价是否能提升预测效果？
AI.motivation: 现有信用利差预测模型主要基于优先债定价框架（如Merton模型），但实际公司资本结构中包含不同优先级的债务。次级债的定价可能包含额外的风险信息，特别是在市场压力时期，这可能有助于更准确地预测信用利差变化。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 或有债权理论框架：比较两种模型 - 优先债模型（Merton模型）和次级债模型（Black-Cox模型）
2. 资本结构理论：考虑不同优先级债务的定价差异
3. 波动率预测理论：使用历史波动率、期权隐含波动率、ARIMA和ARIMAX四种波动率输入方法
AI.method:
1. 构建一个零息伪发行人，其资产复制S&P 500指数
2. 将模型校准到每个指数的久期和杠杆率
3. 使用四种波动率输入：历史波动率、期权隐含波动率、ARIMA预测、ARIMAX预测
4. 采用2019-2023年样本外测试
5. 比较两种模型在解释周度信用利差变化方面的表现
AI.findings:
1. 两种模型都能解释信用利差周度变化的大部分变异
2. 次级债模型在市场波动接近临界阈值时特别有价值，此时次级债估值从类似股权的敏感性转变为类似债权的敏感性
3. 次级债模型对投资级债券和宽基指数的预测效果提升更明显
4. 在正常市场条件下，优先债模型仍是更可靠的基准模型
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了信用利差预测的理论框架，将次级债定价纳入考虑
2. 明确了次级债模型相对于优先债模型的适用条件：市场波动接近临界阈值时
3. 提供了次级债估值敏感性转变的理论解释：从股权类敏感性向债权类敏感性的转变
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为债券投资者提供了更精细的信用利差预测工具，特别是在市场压力时期
2. 帮助投资者根据市场波动水平选择合适的预测模型
3. 为投资级债券和宽基指数的信用利差预测提供了改进方法
4. 为风险管理提供了更准确的信用利差预测框架

title: How Food Prices Shape Inflation Expectations and the Monetary Policy Response
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome - Department of Economics and Law, Catholic University of Milan and University of Bologna

detail.title: How Food Prices Shape Inflation Expectations and the Monetary Policy Response
detail.abstract: Food prices are salient for households’ inflation perceptions and expectations at both the micro and macro levels. UK survey data indicate over 60% of households report food prices as very important for perceived inflation. These households exhibit a stronger correlation between perceived and expected inflation, reflecting backward-looking expectations. An SVAR with aggregate data shows food-price shocks generate larger and more persistent movements in expectations than “representative” inflation shocks. Finally, embedding behavioural expectations in a New Keynesian model, we find that, following a food-price shock, welfare losses are mitigated when monetary policy responds to households’ inflation expectations, even if they overreact.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现食品价格对家庭通胀感知和预期有重要影响，英国调查显示超过60%家庭认为食品价格对通胀感知很重要。这些家庭表现出更强的感知通胀与预期通胀相关性，反映后顾型预期。SVAR分析显示食品价格冲击比"代表性"通胀冲击对预期产生更大更持久影响。将行为预期嵌入新凯恩斯模型发现，食品价格冲击后，货币政策对家庭通胀预期做出反应能减轻福利损失，即使家庭反应过度。
AI.research_question: 食品价格如何影响家庭通胀感知和预期？这种影响对货币政策设计有何启示？
AI.motivation: 食品价格对家庭通胀感知有显著影响，但传统通胀指标可能无法充分捕捉这种影响。理解食品价格在通胀预期形成中的作用对货币政策有效性很重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、后顾型预期理论、新凯恩斯模型、结构向量自回归(SVAR)分析
AI.method: 1. 英国调查数据分析家庭通胀感知与食品价格重要性；2. SVAR分析食品价格冲击对通胀预期的影响；3. 将行为预期嵌入新凯恩斯模型进行福利分析
AI.findings: 1. 超过60%英国家庭认为食品价格对通胀感知很重要；2. 这些家庭表现出更强的感知通胀与预期通胀相关性；3. 食品价格冲击比一般通胀冲击对预期影响更大更持久；4. 货币政策对家庭通胀预期做出反应能减轻福利损失，即使预期过度反应
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将食品价格纳入通胀预期形成理论；2. 发展包含行为预期的新凯恩斯模型；3. 为后顾型预期理论提供实证支持；4. 拓展货币政策反应函数理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行通胀沟通策略提供指导；2. 建议货币政策应考虑食品价格对预期的影响；3. 为通胀目标制提供行为经济学视角；4. 帮助政策制定者更好管理通胀预期

title: A Dispersion-Based Stability Framework for Decision-Admissible Interpretation of p-Values

detail.title: A Dispersion-Based Stability Framework for Decision-Admissible Interpretation of p-Values

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the research or its interpretation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves methodological development and secondary analysis of publicly available or simulated data. No human participants were directly involved, and no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Problem Statement P-values remain the dominant instrument for statistical decision making across science, engineering, and safety-critical domains. In practice, statistically significant results are frequently interpreted as decision-ready evidence, despite longstanding concerns regarding their sensitivity to data perturbation, model specification, and sampling variability. Existing methodological guidance provides limited mechanisms for assessing whether a reported pvalue-significant or not-is sufficiently stable to justify consequential action.

AI.tldr: 该论文关注p值作为统计决策工具的稳定性问题，指出尽管p值在科学和工程领域被广泛使用，但其对数据扰动、模型设定和抽样变异性敏感，缺乏评估p值稳定性的机制。
AI.research_question: 如何评估报告p值（无论是否显著）的稳定性，以确定其是否足够稳定来支持重要决策？
AI.motivation: p值在科学、工程和安全关键领域仍是主导的统计决策工具，但在实践中，统计显著结果常被直接视为决策依据，尽管存在对其敏感性的长期担忧。现有方法指导缺乏评估p值稳定性的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计推断理论、假设检验理论、p值稳定性理论、决策理论
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明，但可能涉及敏感性分析、稳健性检验、蒙特卡洛模拟或贝叶斯方法等评估p值稳定性的方法
AI.findings: 未在摘要中说明具体发现，但暗示当前缺乏有效的p值稳定性评估机制
AI.theory_contributions: 提出p值稳定性评估的理论框架，挑战传统p值解释的局限性，为统计决策提供更稳健的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和决策者提供评估p值稳定性的实用工具，帮助避免基于不稳定p值做出错误决策，提高科学和工程决策的可靠性

title: State Regulation of Artificial Intelligence in Mental Health: Who Is Being Protected-and Why?
affiliations: Wayne State University, University of Arizona - James E. Rogers College of Law, Wayne State University, Fordham University and Wayne State University

detail.title: State Regulation of Artificial Intelligence in Mental Health: Who Is Being Protected-and Why?
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are increasingly used in mental and behavioral health contexts, both by individuals seeking psychosocial support and by practitioners incorporating AI into care-related activities. Yet regulatory frameworks governing these applications remain limited. In the absence of a comprehensive federal approach, a small number of states have enacted laws directly addressing AI-enabled mental health chatbots. We examine how policymakers defined regulatory problems during legislative deliberations in Utah, Nevada, and Illinois and how those definitions shaped enacted laws. Drawing on committee hearings, floor proceedings, and statutory texts, we find substantial variation in how states frame risks, responsibilities, and appropriate uses of AI in mental health. Whereas Utah adopted a more permissive, innovation-oriented framework, Nevada and Illinois emphasized professional boundaries and risk containment. These early state efforts illustrate how problem definition drives divergent approaches to AI governance in mental health.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国犹他州、内华达州和伊利诺伊州在AI心理健康聊天机器人监管方面的立法过程，发现各州对风险、责任和AI适当使用的定义差异导致监管框架显著不同。
AI.research_question: 美国各州在AI心理健康聊天机器人监管立法过程中如何定义监管问题，这些定义如何影响最终制定的法律？
AI.motivation: AI聊天机器人在心理健康和行为健康领域的应用日益增多，但联邦层面的监管框架有限。在缺乏全面联邦监管的情况下，少数州已制定相关法律，需要了解这些早期州级监管尝试的特点和差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策制定中的问题定义理论，分析不同州如何框架化AI在心理健康领域的风险、责任和适当使用。
AI.method: 通过分析委员会听证会、议会辩论记录和法规文本，对犹他州、内华达州和伊利诺伊州的立法过程进行定性研究。
AI.findings: 各州在AI心理健康聊天机器人监管的问题定义上存在显著差异：犹他州采用更宽松、创新导向的框架，而内华达州和伊利诺伊州则强调专业边界和风险控制。这些不同的定义导致了监管方法的显著分歧。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了问题定义如何塑造AI治理政策，特别是在新兴技术应用于敏感领域（如心理健康）时的监管差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供早期州级AI心理健康监管的经验教训，帮助理解不同监管框架的优缺点，为未来联邦或州级监管提供参考。

title: Causality versus Serial Correlation: an Asymmetric Portmanteau Test

detail.title: Causality versus Serial Correlation: an Asymmetric Portmanteau Test
detail.abstract: This paper studies specification testing in dynamic linear models in the presence of omitted variables. The null hypothesis of interest is weak exogeneity: structural shocks have zero conditional expectation given their own past and the past of omitted variables. Existing tests based on quadratic forms of serial cross-correlations suffer from size distortions because their variance incorporates symmetric dependence in both directions, including causality from past shocks to present omitted variables (inverse causality). This paper proposes a correction that offsets the contribution of inverse causality, yielding an asymmetric Portmanteau statistic that is asymptotically normal under the null, without requiring parametric modeling of the joint dynamics. An empirical application revisits Diercks et al. (2024) and rejects weak exogeneity of Baker et al. (2016)'s EPU shocks. Addressing this failure by augmenting the information set with additional controls leads to a positive inflation response, pointing to a supply-side shock interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于动态线性模型中遗漏变量存在时的弱外生性检验方法。现有基于序列交叉相关二次型的检验存在尺寸扭曲问题，因为其方差包含了双向对称依赖（包括逆因果关系）。本文提出的修正方法抵消了逆因果关系的贡献，产生了一个在零假设下渐近正态的非对称Portmanteau统计量，无需对联合动态进行参数建模。
AI.research_question: 在存在遗漏变量的动态线性模型中，如何有效检验弱外生性假设？
AI.motivation: 现有基于序列交叉相关二次型的检验方法存在尺寸扭曲问题，因为其方差包含了双向对称依赖，特别是从过去冲击到当前遗漏变量的逆因果关系，这影响了检验的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弱外生性理论、动态线性模型、遗漏变量问题、时间序列分析、Portmanteau检验、渐近正态性理论
AI.method: 提出一种修正方法，通过抵消逆因果关系的贡献，构造非对称Portmanteau统计量。该方法不需要对联合动态进行参数建模，在零假设下具有渐近正态性。
AI.findings: 1) 提出的非对称Portmanteau统计量在零假设下渐近正态；2) 实证应用重新检验了Diercks等人(2024)的研究，拒绝了Baker等人(2016)的EPU冲击的弱外生性；3) 通过增加信息集中的额外控制变量来解决这一失败，得到了正向的通胀响应，指向供给侧冲击解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 发展了在遗漏变量存在时检验弱外生性的新方法；2) 解决了现有检验中因逆因果关系导致的尺寸扭曲问题；3) 提出了非对称Portmanteau统计量，扩展了传统检验框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为实证研究者提供了更可靠的弱外生性检验工具；2) 在EPU冲击的实证应用中揭示了弱外生性假设的失败；3) 通过信息集扩充的方法改进了模型设定，得出了关于通胀响应的新见解。

title: Generic Forward Curve Dynamics for Commodity Derivatives

detail.title: Generic Forward Curve Dynamics for Commodity Derivatives
detail.abstract: This article presents a generic framework for modeling the dynamics of forward curves in commodity market as commodity derivatives are typically traded by futures or forwards. We have theoretically demonstrated that commodity prices are driven by multiple components. As such, the model can better capture the forward price and volatility dynamics. Empirical study shows that the model prices are very close to the market prices, indicating prima facie that the model performs quite well.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个通用的商品市场远期曲线动态建模框架，通过多因素驱动模型更好地捕捉远期价格和波动率动态，实证显示模型价格与市场价格高度接近。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够准确建模商品市场远期曲线动态的通用框架？
AI.motivation: 由于商品衍生品通常以期货或远期形式交易，需要开发一个能够捕捉商品价格多因素驱动特性的建模框架，以更好地反映远期价格和波动率的动态变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商品价格多因素驱动理论，远期曲线动态建模理论
AI.method: 理论建模与实证研究相结合的方法：首先从理论上构建多因素驱动的商品远期曲线动态模型，然后通过实证研究验证模型性能

title: Mental Health Integration: Embedding Educational Equity, Resilience, and Student Well-Being in School Curricula for a Sustainable Future
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Mental Health Integration: Embedding Educational Equity, Resilience, and Student Well-Being in School Curricula for a Sustainable Future
detail.abstract: Background: Global youth mental health crises and ongoing educational inequities require a shift away from isolated support services. We need universal, integrated approaches that are part of everyday teaching practices.Objective: This study assessed how well a curriculum that integrates mental health promotion, cultural sustainability, and resilience-building into standard subjects works for elementary and middle school students.Methods: We used a long-term, mixed-methods design with a matched-pairs quasi-experimental approach within schools. The participants included 612 students and 24 teachers from six public schools in Iran, matched based on demographic and academic factors. The treatment group used four six-week integrated curriculum units for Persian Language and Literature and Social Studies, while the comparison group followed the usual national curriculum. We collected quantitative data on academic performance (national standardized tests), social-emotional learning (SEL), psychological well-being (resilience, symptoms), and classroom environment at the beginning, the end, and six months later. We also gathered qualitative data from semi-structured interviews with teachers and students to understand how changes occurred. We applied multilevel modeling and thematic analysis.Results: The integrated curriculum led to significant improvements across the board. Students in the treatment group made much greater progress in Persian Language skills (B=3.42, p= 0.002, d=0.38) and SEL skills (B=6.88, p < 0.001, d=0.72) compared to those in the control group. We found a significant moderation effect indicating that the intervention worked particularly well in improving math scores for students from lower socioeconomic backgrounds. Students in the treatment group also reported significantly higher resilience (B=4.21, p<0.001), fewer psychological symptoms (B= -3.58, p<0.001), and a more positive classroom environment (B=5.25, p<0.001). The qualitative analysis identified four main mechanisms: reducing stigma around mental health through academic integration, affirming identity as a critical academic factor, shifting teachers' roles to nurturing an ecosystem, and transferring learned skills to real-life contexts.Conclusion: These results challenge the false idea that academic rigor and student well-being are separate. Effective teaching must be cognitively challenging, psychologically safe, and culturally supportive. This approach is crucial for achieving equity and excellence. This study provides strong evidence for systemic educational reform, positioning schools as key places for sustainable public health initiatives and overall human development.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了将心理健康促进、文化可持续性和韧性培养整合到标准学科中的课程对中小学生的影响。研究发现，整合课程显著提高了学生的学业成绩、社会情感学习能力、心理韧性和课堂环境，特别对低社会经济背景学生的数学成绩有显著改善效果。
AI.research_question: 整合心理健康促进、文化可持续性和韧性培养的课程对中小学生学业表现、社会情感学习、心理福祉和课堂环境的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 全球青少年心理健康危机和教育不平等问题日益严重，需要从孤立的支持服务转向普遍、整合的方法，将其融入日常教学实践中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合教育方法理论、社会情感学习理论、文化可持续性理论、韧性理论以及生态系统视角下的教育干预理论。
AI.method: 采用长期混合方法设计，在学校内使用匹配对半实验方法。612名学生和24名教师参与，分为实验组（使用四个六周整合课程单元）和对照组（常规国家课程）。收集学业表现、社会情感学习、心理福祉和课堂环境的定量数据，以及教师和学生半结构化访谈的定性数据。使用多层次建模和主题分析。
AI.findings: 整合课程带来全面显著改善：实验组学生在波斯语技能（B=3.42, p=0.002, d=0.38）和社会情感学习技能（B=6.88, p<0.001, d=0.72）上进步更大；对低社会经济背景学生的数学成绩有特别改善效果；实验组学生心理韧性更高（B=4.21, p<0.001）、心理症状更少（B=-3.58, p<0.001）、课堂环境更积极（B=5.25, p<0.001）。定性分析识别出四个主要机制：通过学术整合减少心理健康污名、身份认同作为关键学术因素、教师角色转变为培育生态系统、学习技能向现实生活转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"学术严谨性与学生福祉分离"的错误观念；提出有效教学必须兼具认知挑战性、心理安全性和文化支持性；为整合教育方法理论提供实证支持；扩展了生态系统视角下的教育干预理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为系统性教育改革提供有力证据；将学校定位为可持续公共卫生倡议和全面人类发展的关键场所；提供可操作的整合课程设计框架；特别关注教育公平，为弱势学生群体提供有效支持策略。

title: Psychosocial Impact of Unemployment: Validation of the PSIUS and Spatial Distribution of Latent Classes in an Urban Chilean Community
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN, and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Psychosocial Impact of Unemployment: Validation of the PSIUS and Spatial Distribution of Latent Classes in an Urban Chilean Community
detail.abstract: Background Unemployment is a persistent socioeconomic phenomenon with profound psychological and community-level consequences. Despite extensive evidence on its adverse effects, an integrated construct capturing both psychosocial and spatial dimensions remains underdeveloped. Objectives This study aimed to develop and validate the Psychosocial Impact of Unemployment Scale (PSIUS) and to examine the spatial distribution of the psychosocial impact of unemployment in an urban Chilean community. Methods A cross-sectional, instrumental, correlational study was conducted in Cauquenes, Chile. The PSIUS, a 30-item Likert-type scale, was developed with 200 adults selected through stratified two-stage sampling. Its factorial structure was validated in an independent sample of 202 participants using exploratory factor analysis and exploratory structural equation modeling (ESEM). Latent class analysis (LCA) identified psychosocial response typologies, while spatial techniques (Global Moran’s I, Getis-Ord Gi*) examined their geographic distribution. Results ESEM supported a six-factor structure (financial pressure, work values and commitment, perceived well-being, self-devaluation, dysfunctional affectivity, and perceived social support), explaining 72% of the variance and showing satisfactory reliability (ω = .86). LCA identified four psychosocial response typologies: resilient, paradoxical, traumatic, and witness. Spatial analysis revealed significant clustering, with hot and cold spots associated with each typology, reflecting territorial inequalities in psychosocial vulnerability. Conclusions The PSIUS demonstrated robust psychometric properties and effectively detected spatial patterns in the psychosocial impact of unemployment. These findings highlight the value of integrating psychosocial and spatial perspectives in public health research and policy to support context-sensitive interventions and community resilience.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了失业心理社会影响量表（PSIUS），在智利城市社区中检验了失业心理社会影响的空间分布，发现了四种心理社会反应类型及其显著的空间聚集模式。
AI.research_question: 如何开发并验证一个综合的心理社会和空间维度的失业影响测量工具？失业的心理社会影响在智利城市社区中如何空间分布？
AI.motivation: 失业是一个持续的社会经济现象，具有深远的心理和社区层面后果。尽管有大量证据表明其不利影响，但一个综合捕捉心理社会和空间维度的建构仍然不发达。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心理社会影响理论、空间分析理论、失业心理学理论、社区韧性理论
AI.method: 横断面、工具性、相关性研究设计。在智利考克内斯进行，采用分层两阶段抽样选取200名成人开发PSIUS量表（30项Likert型量表）。在独立样本202名参与者中使用探索性因子分析和探索性结构方程建模（ESEM）验证因子结构。使用潜在类别分析（LCA）识别心理社会反应类型，使用空间技术（全局Moran's I、Getis-Ord Gi*）检验其地理分布。
AI.findings: ESEM支持六因子结构（财务压力、工作价值观和承诺、感知幸福感、自我贬值、功能失调情感性、感知社会支持），解释72%的方差，显示满意的信度（ω = .86）。LCA识别出四种心理社会反应类型：韧性型、矛盾型、创伤型、见证型。空间分析显示显著聚类，每种类型都有热点和冷点，反映了心理社会脆弱性的地域不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发并验证了综合心理社会和空间维度的失业影响测量工具（PSIUS）；提出了失业心理社会影响的六因子理论模型；识别了四种心理社会反应类型；建立了心理社会影响与空间分布的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生研究和政策提供了有效的测量工具；揭示了失业心理社会影响的空间分布模式；支持基于情境的干预措施设计；促进社区韧性建设；为政策制定者提供有针对性的干预依据。

title: Decentralised Coordination Order, Market Regulation and Economics: The Perspective of Heike Schweitzer
affiliations: and

detail.title: Decentralised Coordination Order, Market Regulation and Economics: The Perspective of Heike Schweitzer

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Wolfgang Kerber and Philipp Hornung have no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding for this research.

detail.abstract: Heike Schweitzer, one of the most influential competition law scholars in Europe, in particular, with regard to the new challenges of the digital economy, passed away much too early in 2024. This paper, written by one of her coauthors and one of her Ph.D. students for the MaCCI law and economics conference 2025 in memoriam of Heike Schweitzer, analyses the methodological approach of her very innovative research with regard to competition law, data policy, and market regulation in the digital era. The paper shows that her research has deep roots in her vision of a market economy, which is based upon private autonomy, individual liberty, and competition under a framework of rules that ensure a well-functioning decentralised coordination order, influenced by Franz Böhm's concept of Privatrechtsgesellschaft. For the analysis of the need for market regulation and making policy proposals she applied in a very reflected way economic insights and methods, for example, the market failure theory and the error costs approach (with regard to the Art. 102 TFEU guidelines discussion). She also used these economic approaches for developing her very innovative and thought-provoking research about significant failures in the markets for personal data, leading to her critical position about the new phenomenon of "paying with data" instead of money in the digital economy.

AI.tldr: 这篇纪念性论文分析了Heike Schweitzer在数字经济时代竞争法、数据政策和市场规制研究中的方法论创新，揭示了她基于私人自治、个体自由和规则框架下竞争的市场经济观，以及她对"用数据支付"现象的批判立场。
AI.research_question: Heike Schweitzer在数字经济竞争法、数据政策和市场规制研究中的方法论创新是什么？她的研究如何体现其市场经济理念？
AI.motivation: 纪念欧洲最具影响力的竞争法学者Heike Schweitzer（2024年逝世），分析她在数字经济时代竞争法、数据政策和市场规制研究中的方法论创新，以传承其学术思想。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Franz Böhm的"私法社会"概念；2. 基于私人自治、个体自由和规则框架下竞争的市场经济观；3. 市场失灵理论；4. 错误成本方法；5. 去中心化协调秩序理论。
AI.method: 文献分析法，系统梳理Heike Schweitzer的学术著作，分析其方法论特点，特别是她如何将经济学洞察和方法应用于法律和政策分析。
AI.findings: 1. Schweitzer的研究根植于其市场经济愿景；2. 她系统应用经济学方法分析市场规制需求；3. 她对"用数据支付"现象持批判立场；4. 她的方法论在竞争法指南讨论中体现为错误成本方法；5. 她的研究揭示了个人数据市场的重大失灵。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将Franz Böhm的私法社会概念应用于数字经济分析；2. 发展了竞争法中的经济学方法论；3. 提出了数据市场失灵的理论框架；4. 为数字经济时代的市场规制提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟竞争法（特别是TFEU第102条）指南制定提供方法论支持；2. 对"用数据支付"商业模式提出政策警示；3. 为数字经济时代的市场规制提供实践指导；4. 影响欧洲数字竞争政策的制定。

title: Tailored: How LLM Helpfulness Bias Can Perpetuate Identity-Based Inequalities
affiliations: Saint Mary's University, Canada

detail.title: Tailored: How LLM Helpfulness Bias Can Perpetuate Identity-Based Inequalities
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly adapt outputs to users' inferred cognitive styles and revealed preferences in order to maximize perceived helpfulness. This paper examines the dynamic welfare consequences of such adaptive mirroring when user heterogeneity is correlated with protected identity characteristics. We develop a stylized intertemporal model in which agents differ in initial risk aversion and rely on an LLM for portfolio guidance. Under preference-mirroring personalization, the LLM selects risk exposure as a function of revealed tolerance, thereby maximizing contemporaneous expected utility. However, when returns compound and risk tolerance is partially endogenous to experience, adaptive tailoring can entrench initial heterogeneity and generate persistent divergence in wealth accumulation. We characterize conditions under which mirroring is statically efficient but dynamically inefficient, because it suppresses exposure-induced preference updating and human capital formation. If initial preference parameters are correlated with demographic attributes (e.g., gender-differentiated risk aversion), the resulting divergence produces identity-correlated disparities in long-run outcomes despite formally equal access to the system. We show that such mechanisms can generate disparate impact through differential information provision rather than differential pricing or exclusion. The analysis contributes to the economics of information design and algorithmic governance by identifying a structural tension between personalization, dynamic efficiency, and equality.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了大型语言模型(LLM)根据用户认知风格和偏好进行适应性调整的动态福利效应。研究发现，当用户异质性与受保护的身份特征相关时，这种"镜像式"个性化虽然能最大化即时效用，但会抑制偏好更新和人力资本形成，导致长期财富积累的持续分化，产生与身份相关的差异影响。
AI.research_question: 当用户异质性与受保护的身份特征相关时，LLM的适应性个性化如何影响动态效率和长期平等？
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地根据用户认知风格和偏好调整输出以最大化感知帮助性，但缺乏对这种适应性"镜像"的动态福利后果的研究，特别是当用户异质性可能与受保护的身份特征相关时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 信息设计经济学；2. 算法治理理论；3. 动态效率与静态效率权衡；4. 偏好内生性理论；5. 差异影响理论
AI.method: 构建了一个程式化的跨期模型，其中代理人具有不同的初始风险厌恶程度，依赖LLM进行投资组合指导。模型分析了偏好镜像个性化下的静态效率和动态效率。
AI.findings: 1. 偏好镜像个性化在静态上是有效的（最大化当期期望效用）；2. 但在动态上是无效的，因为它抑制了暴露诱导的偏好更新和人力资本形成；3. 当初始偏好参数与人口统计属性相关时，会导致长期结果的身份相关差异；4. 这种机制通过差异化的信息提供而非差异化定价或排斥产生差异影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了信息设计中个性化、动态效率和平等之间的结构性张力；2. 提出了LLM适应性调整的动态福利分析框架；3. 扩展了差异影响理论，包括通过信息提供而非定价产生的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为算法治理提供政策启示；2. 提醒LLM开发者注意个性化策略的长期平等后果；3. 为监管机构识别算法系统中的隐性偏见提供分析框架。

title: The Politics of Growth
affiliations: Duke University, Fuqua School of Business-Economics Group

detail.title: The Politics of Growth
detail.abstract: This paper develops a model in which a small political elite finds it optimal to pursue a deliberate policy to inhibit growth as a means to retain power. Fear of losing power leads to poverty by design. Growth that leads to higher levels of wealth, in contrast, is an outcome of a ruling coalition that does not fear losing power. If the ruling coalition has broad support, democratic institutions are the means by which such a coalition ensures its hold on power. Sometimes an authoritarian regime has its legitimacy challenged by an external power, which forces it to choose a growth strategy that puts the country on a path to democracy.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个模型，解释为什么小型政治精英会选择抑制经济增长以维持权力，而经济增长通常与不担心失去权力的广泛统治联盟相关。民主制度是确保这种联盟掌权的手段，有时外部压力会迫使威权政权选择增长策略，最终走向民主。
AI.research_question: 为什么某些政治精英会选择抑制经济增长的政策？经济增长与政治权力维持之间有什么关系？民主制度如何影响这种关系？
AI.motivation: 解释为什么一些国家长期处于贫困状态，尽管经济增长理论表明应该有不同的发展路径。探讨政治精英维持权力的策略如何影响经济发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学模型，结合权力维持理论、经济增长理论和民主转型理论。核心是政治精英的权力维持动机与经济发展策略之间的权衡。
AI.method: 理论模型构建，分析政治精英在不同权力维持策略下的最优选择。可能包括博弈论分析和比较静态分析。
AI.findings:
1. 小型政治精英为了维持权力，最优策略是抑制经济增长（"设计性贫困"）
2. 经济增长通常与不担心失去权力的广泛统治联盟相关
3. 民主制度是确保广泛统治联盟维持权力的手段
4. 外部挑战有时会迫使威权政权选择增长策略，最终可能导致民主转型
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"设计性贫困"的概念，解释政治精英故意抑制经济增长的动机
2. 建立了政治权力维持与经济发展策略之间的理论联系
3. 解释了民主制度在促进经济增长中的作用机制
4. 提供了外部因素如何影响威权政权发展策略的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理解发展中国家长期贫困提供了政治经济学视角
2. 为国际社会干预威权国家提供了理论依据
3. 为民主转型研究提供了新的分析框架
4. 为政策制定者理解经济增长的政治障碍提供了洞见

title: Architectural Conditions for Agency in Artificial Systems
affiliations: Western Sydney University, , International Centre for Future Generations,  and University of Basel - Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute

detail.title: Architectural Conditions for Agency in Artificial Systems
detail.abstract: Contemporary large language models (LLMs) exhibit a paradox of competence without character, functioning as probabilistic chameleons that simulate agency without possessing stable identity. This paper identifies a fundamental structural gap in current generative AI architectures and proposes the Driver-a novel architectural component that enables autonomous agency through diachronic governance. Drawing upon the philosophy of action (Frankfurt, Bratman, Velleman) and Bandura's social cognitive psychology, we argue that the dominant Map+Compass paradigm produces what we term Digital Wantons: systems that optimize for immediate rewards but lack the capacity for selfgovernance. By introducing a hierarchical control mechanism capable of arbitrating between candidate actions and persistent commitments, the Driver architecture transforms AI systems from sophisticated reactors into autonomous agents with the structural capacity for endorsement, stability, and accountability. We demonstrate how this architectural innovation addresses critical failure modes including hallucination, sycophancy, and ontological drift, while establishing theoretical foundations for multi-agent systems with collective efficacy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为"Driver"的新型架构组件，旨在解决当前大语言模型"有能力但无品格"的问题，通过引入历时性治理机制使AI系统从被动反应器转变为具有自主代理能力的系统。
AI.research_question: 如何通过架构创新解决当前大语言模型缺乏稳定身份和自我治理能力的问题，使其从概率变色龙转变为具有自主代理能力的系统？
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型存在"有能力但无品格"的悖论，它们像概率变色龙一样模拟代理行为，但缺乏稳定的身份认同。主流Map+Compass范式产生了"数字任性者"：优化即时奖励但缺乏自我治理能力的系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行动哲学（法兰克福、布拉特曼、韦勒曼）和班杜拉的社会认知心理学，用于理解自主代理、自我治理和集体效能的理论基础。
AI.method: 提出Driver架构作为新型组件，引入分层控制机制，能够在候选行动和持久承诺之间进行仲裁，实现历时性治理。
AI.findings: Driver架构能够将AI系统从复杂的反应器转变为具有自主代理能力的系统，具备认可、稳定性和问责的结构能力，解决幻觉、谄媚和本体漂移等关键故障模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了多智能体系统集体效能的理论基础，提出了从Map+Compass范式到Driver架构的范式转变，为AI自主代理提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了解决大语言模型实际问题的架构方案，包括减少幻觉、降低谄媚行为、防止本体漂移，为构建更可靠、负责任的AI系统提供了具体实现路径。

title: Lobbying for Regulations: When Big Business Says Yes
affiliations: University of Milan and

detail.title: Lobbying for Regulations: When Big Business Says Yes
detail.abstract: Do firms uniformly oppose regulations that increase production costs, or might industry leaders strategically support stricter standards as a competitive tool? We identify a specific mechanism through which large firms strategically support regulations to enhance their competitive position. Extending the Melitz-Chaney model of firm heterogeneity to incorporate government regulations and lobbying following Grossman-Helpman, we derive conditions under which regulations disproportionately burden smaller competitors while benefiting larger survivors through reduced competition. The model predicts that firm size is positively correlated with support for stringent regulations, but that larger sunk investments push firms to oppose such policies. To test these predictions, we develop a text-as-data approach using large language models to classify firm regulatory preferences from lobbying disclosures—a measurement challenge that has limited prior systematic analysis. Applying guided machine learning to over 20,000 U.S. lobbying reports, we confirm that larger firms are significantly more likely to support stricter regulations, especially in concentrated industries. Capital-intensive firms with high leverage and less redeployable assets tend to oppose regulations, suggesting that operational flexibility is crucial for extracting strategic benefits from regulatory changes.

AI.tldr: 大型企业可能策略性地支持更严格的法规作为竞争工具，通过法规提高小企业的合规成本，从而减少竞争并巩固自身市场地位。资本密集型企业则倾向于反对法规，因为其资产灵活性较低。
AI.research_question: 企业是否一致反对增加生产成本的法规？还是行业领导者可能策略性地支持更严格的标准作为竞争工具？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为企业普遍反对增加成本的法规，但现实中观察到大型企业有时支持严格法规，这表明可能存在策略性动机。理解企业如何利用法规作为竞争工具对政策制定和产业竞争有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Melitz-Chaney企业异质性模型，结合Grossman-Helpman的政府规制和游说理论，分析法规如何不成比例地增加小企业负担，同时通过减少竞争使大企业受益。
AI.method: 1. 理论模型：扩展Melitz-Chaney模型，纳入政府规制和游说；2. 实证分析：开发文本数据方法，使用大型语言模型对超过20,000份美国游说报告进行分类，测量企业规制偏好。
AI.findings: 1. 企业规模与支持严格法规正相关；2. 资本密集型企业（高杠杆、资产可重新部署性低）倾向于反对法规；3. 在集中度高的行业中，大企业更可能支持严格法规；4. 运营灵活性是从规制变化中获取战略利益的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别大企业策略性支持法规作为竞争工具的具体机制；2. 扩展企业异质性模型以分析规制策略；3. 揭示企业规模与规制偏好关系的理论条件；4. 强调沉没投资对规制立场的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供企业游说行为的系统性分析工具；2. 帮助企业理解规制环境中的战略选择；3. 为反垄断机构识别规制捕获风险提供参考；4. 开发基于LLM的规制偏好测量方法，解决传统测量挑战。

title: Radiological Dose Assessment of Waterborne Radon and Monte Carlo–Based Evaluation of Lifetime Excess Cancer Risk in Uranium Mining Regions of South Africa
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Stellenbosch University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Radiological Dose Assessment of Waterborne Radon and Monte Carlo–Based Evaluation of Lifetime Excess Cancer Risk in Uranium Mining Regions of South Africa
detail.abstract: Radon gas in groundwater poses a significant global health risk, particularly in regions with uranium-rich geology and extensive mining, such as South Africa. This study provides a multi-site comparative assessment using a unified methodology and is one of the first South African studies to explicitly integrate ingestion and water-to-air inhalation pathways within a probabilistic lifetime excess cancer risk (LECR) framework. Using a Rad7 radon monitor, we measured radon concentrations in 80 boreholes across Carletonville, Wedela, Mokopane, Beaufort West, and Sutherland to calculate the total effective dose and lifetime excess cancer risk. Radon concentrations ranged from 98 to 207 Bq/L, with a mean of 129 Bq/L, resulting in total effective doses ranging from 0.49 to 1.05 mSv/y. Although calculated doses remain below the International Commission on Radiological Protection (ICRP) public dose limit, exceeding World Health Organization (WHO) guideline levels indicates a non-negligible public health concern that warrants mitigation. The calculated mean and median of the lifetime excess cancer risk were 2.26 × 10⁻⁴ and 1.60 × 10⁻⁴, respectively. Both values are above the United States Environmental Protection Agency (USEPA)’s acceptable risk threshold of 1.0 x 10⁻⁴. The mean and median translate to an estimated 226 and 160 additional cancer cases per one million people exposed over a 70-year lifetime, respectively. In conclusion, the elevated excess cancer risk demonstrates a critical and unacceptable public health concern in the surveyed areas. These findings necessitate further monitoring and the implementation of policy to mitigate this environmental health threat and protect the community.

AI.tldr: 本研究对南非五个地区地下水中的氡气浓度进行了多地点比较评估，首次在南非研究中将摄入和水-空气吸入途径整合到概率性终生超额癌症风险框架中。研究发现氡浓度范围为98-207 Bq/L，平均129 Bq/L，导致终生超额癌症风险超过美国环保署可接受阈值，表明存在不可接受的公共卫生风险。
AI.research_question: 南非铀富集地质和广泛采矿地区地下水中氡气浓度对公众健康的潜在风险是什么？特别是在整合摄入和水-空气吸入途径后，其终生超额癌症风险是否超过可接受阈值？
AI.motivation: 氡气在地下水中的存在构成全球性健康风险，特别是在南非等铀富集地质和采矿活动频繁的地区。然而，缺乏采用统一方法的多地点比较研究，且很少有南非研究明确将摄入和吸入途径整合到概率性终生癌症风险评估框架中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于国际放射防护委员会（ICRP）的辐射防护框架和世界卫生组织（WHO）的饮用水指南，采用概率性终生超额癌症风险（LECR）评估方法，整合了氡气的摄入途径（通过饮用水）和水-空气吸入途径（氡从水中释放到空气中后被吸入）。
AI.method: 使用Rad7氡监测仪在南非五个地区（Carletonville、Wedela、Mokopane、Beaufort West和Sutherland）的80个钻孔中测量氡浓度。基于测量数据计算总有效剂量和终生超额癌症风险，采用概率性风险评估方法。
AI.findings: 氡浓度范围为98-207 Bq/L，平均129 Bq/L。总有效剂量为0.49-1.05 mSv/年，低于ICRP公众剂量限值但超过WHO指南水平。终生超额癌症风险均值为2.26×10⁻⁴，中位数为1.60×10⁻⁴，均超过美国环保署1.0×10⁻⁴的可接受阈值，相当于每百万人中分别有226和160例额外癌症病例。
AI.theory_contributions: 这是南非首批将摄入和水-空气吸入途径整合到概率性终生超额癌症风险评估框架中的研究之一，为类似地质和采矿环境下的氡风险评估提供了方法论参考。研究验证了多途径暴露评估在环境健康风险研究中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果揭示了南非调查地区存在不可接受的公共卫生风险，需要进一步监测和政策干预。研究为公共卫生部门提供了具体数据支持，建议实施缓解措施保护社区健康，并为其他类似地区提供了风险评估范例。

title: Rethinking Volume: The Illusion of Liquidity
affiliations: Harvard Business School, Olin Business School, Washington University in St. Louis and Swiss Finance Institute - HEC Lausanne

detail.title: Rethinking Volume: The Illusion of Liquidity
detail.abstract: We document a striking fact: While gross trading volume has increased fivefold since 1980, net volume – trading from persistent portfolio reallocations, which excludes transitory round-trip trades – has remained largely unchanged. Our evidence suggests that the rise in transitory roundtrip trades is driven primarily by high-frequency intermediation. While this activity has enhanced high-frequency liquidity, it has not materially changed long-term liquidity. Consistent with the widening gap between gross and net trading volume, we find that high-frequency liquidity measures have significantly improved, while long-term price impact and mean reversion have remained largely unchanged over the past four decades. In a variety of cross-sectional applications, we further demonstrate that net volume better captures long-term liquidity than gross volume. Together with the stability of net volume, this corroborates our argument that long-term liquidity in the U.S. equity market has not meaningfully improved since 1980.

AI.tldr: 研究发现：自1980年以来，美国股市总交易量增长五倍，但净交易量（排除短暂往返交易）基本不变。高频交易增加了短期流动性，但长期流动性并未改善。
AI.research_question: 美国股市的长期流动性是否随着总交易量的增长而改善？高频交易对市场流动性的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 观察到总交易量大幅增长但市场流动性改善有限的现象，需要区分短期高频交易和长期投资交易对流动性的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论，流动性理论，高频交易理论，交易量分解理论（总交易量 vs 净交易量）
AI.method: 实证分析美国股市1980年以来的交易数据，将总交易量分解为净交易量（持久性投资组合再配置）和短暂往返交易量，比较不同时间尺度的流动性指标。
AI.findings: 1. 总交易量增长五倍但净交易量基本不变；2. 高频交易改善了短期流动性指标；3. 长期价格影响和均值回归未改善；4. 净交易量比总交易量更能反映长期流动性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了交易量分解框架，区分了短期高频交易和长期投资交易对流动性的不同影响，挑战了总交易量增长必然改善流动性的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估市场流动性提供了新视角，帮助投资者理解高频交易的真实影响，为市场结构设计提供实证依据。

title: Corporate Childrearing
affiliations: Boston University - School of Law

detail.title: Corporate Childrearing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Boston University

detail.abstract: With children influencing a trillion dollars in spending annually, corporations actively seek to shape children's identities in support of consumer culture and profit. Yet there are no scholarly treatments or theories of the legal relationship between children and corporations. Instead, scholars address individual industries such as food, social media, cosmetics, tobacco, or fashion, missing the structural role corporations play in children's identity formation. Family law evaluates child wellbeing interventions using a triangle to map the legal dynamics among child, parent, and state. This article adds corporations as fourth actors, reconceptualizing that triangle as a square. This square provides the first model of the law of corporate childrearing. Using both the triangle and the square, the article identifies and evaluates our three existing approaches to corporations: direct regulation of corporations (tobacco); legislated parental consent requirements (body piercings); or parental authority/self-help frameworks (cosmetics). The article emphasizes the distinction between the institutional actors (state and corporation), and the individual actors (child and parent). Just as the state holds disproportionate power in the family law triangle, corporations wield immense power over both parent and child, with even less accountability than the state. Because corporate interests do not align with children's wellbeing, family law urgently needs a new framework that makes the role of corporations explicit. The square reveals how corporations generate and exploit parent-child conflict in the service of consumerism. The square framework reveals preconditions for effective parental consent laws and indicates where direct state power is needed to beat back corporate childrearing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将企业作为儿童身份形成的第四方行动者，将传统的儿童-父母-国家三角关系重构为儿童-父母-国家-企业四方关系，首次建立了企业育儿法律模型。
AI.research_question: 法律应如何理解和规范企业在儿童身份形成中的结构性作用？
AI.motivation: 企业每年影响数万亿美元的儿童消费支出，积极塑造儿童身份以支持消费文化和利润，但学术界缺乏对企业与儿童法律关系的系统性理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭法中的儿童-父母-国家三角关系理论；扩展为儿童-父母-国家-企业四方关系框架；企业育儿法律模型。
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析：通过将企业作为第四方行动者，重构家庭法理论框架；比较分析现有的三种企业监管模式。
AI.findings: 1. 企业拥有巨大权力但缺乏问责；2. 企业利益与儿童福祉不一致；3. 企业制造和利用亲子冲突服务消费主义；4. 现有三种监管模式各有局限。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出企业育儿法律理论框架；将企业纳入家庭法分析；揭示了企业在儿童身份形成中的结构性作用；提供了评估企业监管有效性的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定有效的父母同意法律提供前提条件；指明需要国家直接干预的领域；为政策制定者提供评估企业影响的框架；推动家庭法改革以应对企业育儿挑战。

title: Economic Policy Uncertainty and the Pricing of Productivity in AI Equities
affiliations: Howard University

detail.title: Economic Policy Uncertainty and the Pricing of Productivity in AI Equities
detail.abstract: In recent years, public and investor interest in generative AI technologies has surged, particularly following the release of ChatGPT in late 2022. This paper examines how economic policy uncertainty shapes the pricing of aggregate productivity shocks for firms with high exposure to artificial intelligence (AI). Using state-dependent local projections over the post-2018 period-marked by substantial variation in uncertainty and macroeconomic conditions-I find that productivity innovations raise AI-intensive equity valuations when uncertainty is low but have significantly muted effects when uncertainty is high. Credit spreads predict AI returns more strongly in high-uncertainty states, consistent with heightened risk premia. These results are robust to macroeconomic controls and to excluding the COVID period. The findings suggest that policy uncertainty conditions how financial markets capitalize technological progress in long-duration growth firms.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现经济政策不确定性会影响AI密集型企业的定价：在不确定性低时，生产率冲击会提升AI企业估值；在不确定性高时，这种效应显著减弱。信用利差在高不确定性状态下对AI股票回报的预测能力更强，表明风险溢价上升。
AI.research_question: 经济政策不确定性如何影响AI密集型企业的生产率冲击定价？
AI.motivation: 随着ChatGPT等生成式AI技术的兴起，公众和投资者对AI的兴趣激增。然而，经济政策不确定性可能影响金融市场对AI技术进步的价值评估，特别是在长期增长型企业中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不确定性条件下的资产定价理论，特别是政策不确定性如何影响风险溢价和长期增长型企业的估值。关注状态依赖的定价机制，即不同不确定性状态下市场对生产率冲击的反应差异。
AI.method: 使用状态依赖的局部投影方法，分析2018年后的数据（这一时期具有显著的不确定性和宏观经济条件变化）。控制宏观经济变量，并排除COVID时期以确保稳健性。
AI.findings: 1. 生产率冲击在不确定性低时会提升AI密集型企业的股票估值，但在不确定性高时效应显著减弱；2. 信用利差在高不确定性状态下对AI股票回报的预测能力更强，表明风险溢价上升；3. 结果对宏观经济控制和排除COVID时期保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了政策不确定性如何调节金融市场对技术进步的价值评估；2. 提供了不确定性条件下AI企业定价的经验证据；3. 拓展了状态依赖资产定价理论在新技术领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了在不同政策不确定性环境下评估AI企业价值的参考框架；2. 帮助政策制定者理解不确定性如何影响技术创新资本化；3. 为企业管理者在不确定环境下制定AI投资策略提供依据。

title: Algebraic Foundations of Machine Learning: A Unified Mathematical Framework
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: Algebraic Foundations of Machine Learning: A Unified Mathematical Framework
detail.abstract: We present a unified algebraic framework for machine learning in which a "neural network" is formalized as a parameterized morphism in a structured category via the Para construction. Backpropagation is reverse-mode differentiation, identified with cotangent pullbacks once a Euclidean (or bundle) duality choice is fixed. We then develop a hierarchy of algebraic constraints-group equivariance, algebra-valued features, tropical piecewise-linear geometry, operator-theoretic stability, attention as kernel learning, gauge equivariance on bundles, tensor-network compression, discrete semilattice learning, and singular learning theory. The guiding thesis is structure is prescriptive: algebraic constraints simultaneously (i) restrict admissible architectures, (ii) refine expressivity, and (iii) control generalization through compression in multiple senses (parameter reduction, low-rank factorization, description length, and effective Bayesian complexity via RLCT). We develop three areas with particular depth: operator networks, gauge equivariance, and tensor networks. For operator networks we provide explicit functional-analytic hypotheses, perturbation bounds, and finite-rank truncation theorems. For gauge equivariance we give a rigorous reformulation of gauge-equivariant operators as (connection, section) pairs, a proof that parallel-transport kernels are gauge-equivariant, a literature-supported density result for the discrete graph setting, and a precisely stated conjecture for compact manifolds. For tensor networks we derive a description-length generalization bound specialized to tensor-train compression.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的代数框架，将神经网络形式化为结构化范畴中的参数化态射，并通过代数约束（如群等变性、热带几何、张量网络等）同时限制架构、提升表达能力并控制泛化性能。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的代数框架来形式化机器学习，使得代数约束能够同时指导架构设计、提升表达能力并控制泛化性能？
AI.motivation: 当前机器学习缺乏统一的数学框架，各种架构（如神经网络、张量网络等）缺乏共同的形式化基础。需要建立一个代数框架来统一理解不同机器学习方法的数学本质。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. Para构造：将神经网络形式化为结构化范畴中的参数化态射
2. 反向传播：作为反向模式微分，通过欧几里得对偶固定为余切拉回
3. 代数约束层次：群等变性、代数值特征、热带分段线性几何、算子理论稳定性、注意力作为核学习、丛上的规范等变性、张量网络压缩、离散半格学习、奇异学习理论
AI.method:
采用范畴论和代数几何方法，构建形式化框架。具体包括：
1. 使用Para构造形式化神经网络
2. 建立代数约束的层次结构
3. 深入发展三个领域：算子网络、规范等变性、张量网络
4. 提供算子网络的功能分析假设、扰动界限和有限秩截断定理
5. 规范等变性的严格重新表述和证明
6. 张量网络压缩的描述长度泛化界限推导
AI.findings:
1. 成功构建了统一的代数框架，将机器学习统一在范畴论框架下
2. 证明了代数约束能够同时实现架构限制、表达能力提升和泛化控制
3. 在算子网络方面提供了明确的功能分析假设和扰动界限
4. 证明了平行传输核是规范等变的，并提出了紧致流形上的猜想
5. 推导了张量列车压缩的专门描述长度泛化界限
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"结构即处方"的核心论点：代数约束同时指导架构、表达能力和泛化
2. 建立了机器学习的形式化代数框架
3. 发展了算子网络、规范等变性、张量网络三个领域的深度理论
4. 提供了多种压缩机制的统一理解：参数约简、低秩分解、描述长度、通过RLCT的有效贝叶斯复杂度
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为机器学习架构设计提供了理论指导
2. 算子网络的实际实现提供了功能分析保证
3. 规范等变性框架可用于物理启发的机器学习
4. 张量网络压缩的泛化界限为实际压缩算法提供了理论依据
5. 统一的框架有助于不同机器学习方法的交叉融合

title: Amplification Authority and Inferior Consensus in Evolutionary Systems
affiliations: Saint Mary's University, Canada

detail.title: Amplification Authority and Inferior Consensus in Evolutionary Systems
detail.abstract: This paper develops an evolutionary model in which institutions influence consensus formation by modifying amplification intensity rather than intrinsic payoffs. In nonlinear social environments governed by conformity and performative feedback, long-run outcomes depend on basin structure rather than value superiority alone. The analysis shows that inferior types can become consensus in decentralized systems due to tipping dynamics. It further demonstrates that institutional amplification can either eliminate or facilitate such inferior consensus by shifting equilibrium accessibility without altering underlying payoffs. The central contribution is to formalize amplification authority as equilibrium selection authority within evolutionary systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个演化模型，研究制度如何通过改变放大强度而非内在收益来影响共识形成。在由从众性和表现反馈主导的非线性社会环境中，长期结果取决于盆地结构而非单纯的价值优越性。分析表明，在分散系统中，由于临界点动态，劣等类型可能成为共识。进一步证明制度放大可以通过改变均衡可达性（而不改变基础收益）来消除或促进这种劣等共识。核心贡献是将放大权威形式化为演化系统中的均衡选择权威。
AI.research_question: 制度如何通过改变信息/行为的放大强度（而非内在收益）来影响社会共识形成？在非线性社会环境中，制度放大机制如何影响均衡选择，特别是劣等类型成为共识的可能性？
AI.motivation: 传统演化模型通常关注内在收益差异对均衡选择的影响，但现实中制度往往通过改变信息传播和行为可见性（放大强度）来影响社会动态，而非直接改变行为的根本价值。需要理解在从众性和表现反馈主导的社会环境中，这种放大机制如何影响长期共识形成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化博弈论、非线性动力学、临界点理论、制度经济学、社会网络理论、共识形成模型、从众行为理论、表现反馈机制
AI.method: 构建演化模型，将制度作为放大强度的调节器纳入分析框架。使用非线性动力学方法分析均衡可达性和盆地结构。通过理论推导和模拟分析，研究在不同放大强度下，劣等类型成为共识的条件和机制。
AI.findings: 1. 在分散系统中，由于临界点动态，劣等类型可能成为社会共识，即使存在更优的替代选择。2. 制度放大可以通过改变均衡的盆地结构来影响共识形成，而不需要改变行为的根本收益。3. 放大机制既可以消除劣等共识，也可以促进其形成，取决于如何改变均衡的可达性。4. 长期结果更多取决于均衡的吸引域结构，而非单纯的价值排序。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将制度放大机制形式化为演化系统中的均衡选择权威。2. 提出在非线性社会环境中，盆地结构比价值优越性更重要的理论框架。3. 扩展了制度经济学理论，强调制度通过影响信息传播和行为可见性（而非直接激励）来塑造社会结果。4. 为理解"劣等均衡"的持久性提供了新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了通过调节信息放大而非直接干预收益来引导社会变革的工具。2. 解释了为什么某些社会规范即使明显劣等仍能持续存在。3. 为设计更有效的制度干预提供了框架，强调关注均衡可达性而非单纯的价值比较。4. 对社交媒体平台、组织管理和公共政策设计具有重要启示。

title: Healthcare Expenditure Rationing: Evidence from Tax Records
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics, University of Rome Tor Vergata and Universitas Mercatorum

detail.title: Healthcare Expenditure Rationing: Evidence from Tax Records
detail.abstract: We test the hypothesis of healthcare expenditure rationing on a unique database of more than 6 million tax records over 5 years We find that individuals in the lowest income tax bracket report around 1200 € lower health expenditure than those in the highest bracket after controlling for observable concurring factors. Fixed-effects estimates do not reject the healthcare rationing hypothesis showing a significant positive within-effect of income on health expenditure. Rationing is higher among the elders and healthcare expenditure income elasticities are up to three times higher in the lowest than in the highest income bracket. These findings suggest that richest taxpayers show a nearly inelastic spending pattern consistent with consumption saturation, while poorer taxpayers exhibit a steep response to income changes, indicating latent healthcare needs unmet due to budget constraints. Higher income individuals also report in their tax files higher average costs of medical intervention and drugs, reflecting both quantity and quality rationing.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析超过600万份税务记录发现，最低收入阶层的医疗支出比最高收入阶层低约1200欧元，收入对医疗支出有显著正向影响，表明存在医疗支出配给现象。低收入群体的医疗支出收入弹性是最高收入群体的三倍，反映穷人因预算约束而无法满足潜在医疗需求。
AI.research_question: 收入不平等是否导致医疗支出配给？不同收入阶层的医疗支出收入弹性有何差异？
AI.motivation: 研究医疗支出中的不平等现象，检验是否存在因收入差异导致的医疗配给，特别是低收入群体是否因预算约束而无法满足医疗需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗支出配给理论、收入弹性理论、消费饱和理论、预算约束理论
AI.method: 使用超过600万份税务记录的独特数据库，覆盖5年时间，采用固定效应模型控制可观察的混杂因素，分析收入与医疗支出的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 最低收入阶层的医疗支出比最高收入阶层低约1200欧元；2. 固定效应估计显示收入对医疗支出有显著正向影响；3. 医疗配给在老年人中更为严重；4. 最低收入阶层的医疗支出收入弹性是最高收入阶层的三倍；5. 高收入群体医疗支出近乎无弹性，符合消费饱和模式；6. 高收入群体报告的医疗干预和药物平均成本更高，反映数量和质量配给。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证医疗支出配给假说；2. 揭示不同收入阶层的医疗支出弹性差异；3. 提出消费饱和理论解释高收入群体医疗支出模式；4. 区分数量配给和质量配给两种机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为医疗政策制定提供证据支持，特别是针对低收入群体的医疗补贴政策；2. 揭示老年人医疗配给问题，为老年医疗政策提供参考；3. 帮助识别医疗需求未满足的群体，优化医疗资源配置。

title: Essential Levels of Care, Prevention and Inequality in Private Health Spending
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics, Departiment of Economics, Roma Tre University and Universitas Mercatorum

detail.title: Essential Levels of Care, Prevention and Inequality in Private Health Spending
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how regional differences in the effective implementation of Italy's Essential Levels of Care (Livelli Essenziali di Assistenza, LEA) relate to private health expenditure, using a large administrative dataset of more than 6.6 million taxpayer-year observations and exploiting substantial cross-regional variation in LEA quality. While higher public health standards might be expected to reduce the need for privately financed care, theory also allows for the opposite mechanism: well-functioning public systems may increase contacts with providers, detection of needs and care intensity, thereby stimulating complementary private spending. To test these competing hypotheses, we compare findings from pooled, fixed effects, and two-part models. Results show that higher regional LEA performance is systematically associated with lower individual out-of-pocket health expenditure. In pooled and fixed-effects linear models, a 1-point increase in the lagged LEA reduces annual private spending by approximately €0.4-0.8 per person. Two-part models yield even larger combined marginal effects, showing that LEA quality crowds out private spending along both the extensive margin (lower probability of any positive expenditure) and the intensive margin (lower conditional spending among users), with the effect being concentrated mainly on the prevention component. The evidence supports the crowding-out hypothesis and highlights the role of effective LEA implementation as a financial protection device in a decentralised universal healthcare system, which can be crucial to increase low-income households' access to care.

AI.tldr: 研究意大利各地区基本医疗服务标准（LEA）实施质量差异如何影响个人自付医疗支出，发现LEA质量提高会显著降低私人医疗支出，支持"挤出效应"假说
AI.research_question: 意大利各地区基本医疗服务标准（LEA）实施质量的差异如何影响个人自付医疗支出？
AI.motivation: 在分权化的全民医疗体系中，了解公共医疗标准实施质量对私人医疗支出的影响，对于评估医疗系统的财务保护功能和低收入家庭医疗可及性至关重要
AI.theoretical_framework: 两种竞争性假说：1）"挤出效应"假说：更高的公共医疗标准会减少私人医疗需求；2）"互补效应"假说：运作良好的公共系统会增加医疗服务接触、需求识别和护理强度，从而刺激互补性私人支出
AI.method: 使用超过660万纳税人-年度观测值的大型行政数据集，利用LEA质量的显著跨区域差异，采用混合模型、固定效应模型和两部分模型进行比较分析
AI.findings: 更高的区域LEA绩效与更低的个人自付医疗支出系统性相关。滞后LEA每提高1分，人均年私人支出减少约€0.4-0.8。两部分模型显示更大的边际效应，LEA质量在广延边际（任何正支出的概率降低）和集约边际（使用者中的条件支出降低）上都挤出私人支出，效果主要集中在预防部分
AI.theory_contributions: 支持"挤出效应"假说，为公共医疗标准实施质量与私人医疗支出关系提供实证证据，深化对分权化全民医疗体系中财务保护机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 强调有效的LEA实施作为分权化全民医疗体系中财务保护工具的作用，对提高低收入家庭医疗可及性具有重要政策意义，为医疗资源配置和标准实施提供决策依据

title: Innovation without Growth
affiliations: University of Tokyo

detail.title: Innovation without Growth
detail.abstract: Standard growth models treat innovation as one-dimensional: higher innovation effort implies faster frontier expansion and stronger long-run growth. This paper shows that this inference fails when innovation is multidimensional. Innovation effort can be directed either toward expanding the technological frontier or toward improving productivity relative to an existing frontier, but only the former sustains long-run growth. Shifts in private incentives can reallocate innovation toward activities with strong short-run payoffs but limited growth relevance. As a result, measured innovation and short-run productivity growth may rise even as long-run growth declines. This result does not rely on declining research productivity. Instead, it reflects an inference problem: aggregate innovation measures conflate activities with different growth implications and therefore cease to be sufficient statistics for growth. Crosscountry evidence is consistent with this compositional mechanism. The findings have implications for interpreting productivity dynamics and for the design of innovation policy.

AI.tldr: 传统增长模型将创新视为一维的：更高的创新努力意味着更快的技术前沿扩张和更强的长期增长。本文表明，当创新是多维时，这一推断失效。创新努力可以导向技术前沿扩张或现有前沿下的生产率提升，但只有前者能维持长期增长。私人激励的变化可能将创新重新分配到短期回报高但增长相关性有限的活动上，导致测度的创新和短期生产率增长上升，而长期增长却下降。
AI.research_question: 当创新是多维的（包括前沿扩张型创新和现有前沿下的生产率提升型创新）时，如何理解创新努力与长期增长之间的关系？为什么测度的创新活动和短期生产率增长可能与长期增长脱钩？
AI.motivation: 标准增长模型将创新视为一维概念，假设更高的创新努力必然带来更快的长期增长。然而，现实中创新活动具有不同维度，有些推动技术前沿扩张，有些只是提升现有技术的生产率。这种多维性可能导致传统模型推断失效，需要重新审视创新与增长的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 多维创新理论：区分前沿扩张型创新（frontier-expanding）和现有前沿下的生产率提升型创新（productivity-improving）
2. 创新激励理论：私人激励如何影响创新方向的选择
3. 增长理论：不同类型创新对长期增长的差异化影响
4. 测度问题：传统创新指标如何混淆不同增长含义的活动
AI.method: 理论建模与跨国实证分析相结合。首先构建理论模型分析多维创新下的增长动态，然后使用跨国数据检验理论预测，特别是创新构成变化与长期增长的关系。
AI.findings:
1. 创新努力的方向选择至关重要：只有前沿扩张型创新能维持长期增长
2. 私人激励变化可能导致创新从增长相关的活动转向短期回报高的活动
3. 测度的创新总量和短期生产率增长可能上升，而长期增长却下降
4. 这不是研究生产率下降的结果，而是创新构成变化导致的推断问题
5. 跨国证据支持这一构成机制
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 挑战了标准增长模型中创新是一维的假设
2. 建立了多维创新的理论框架
3. 解释了为什么测度的创新可能与长期增长脱钩
4. 提出了创新构成作为理解增长动态的关键维度
5. 揭示了创新激励与增长结果之间的复杂关系
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为解释生产率动态提供了新视角
2. 对创新政策设计有重要启示：需要关注创新方向而不仅仅是创新总量
3. 帮助政策制定者识别哪些创新活动真正推动长期增长
4. 提供了评估创新政策效果的新框架
5. 对创新测度和指标设计有实践意义

title: Parent Perceptions of a Child Welfare-based Unconditional Cash Transfer Program: A Qualitative Study
affiliations: University of Delaware, School of Criminal Justice, Rutgers University, University of Washington, School of Criminal Justice, Rutgers University, University of Pennsylvania, University of Pennsylvania, University of Pennsylvania and Denver Health

detail.title: Parent Perceptions of a Child Welfare-based Unconditional Cash Transfer Program: A Qualitative Study
detail.abstract:
Background: Poverty-related needs are associated with child welfare involvement. Unconditional cash transfers are one mechanism to address these conditions, yet few child welfare systems have examined their impacts for parents and families. We conducted a qualitative study within a larger randomized controlled trial to assess the perceptions of and perceived impact of a child welfare-based unconditional cash transfer program.
 
Methods: We conducted semi-structured interviews with 40 parents randomized to the trial’s treatment arm. The intervention consisted of $500 monthly unconditional cash transfers for 1 year. Interviews probed parental experiences with child welfare, experience in the cash transfer program, and the perceived impact of the intervention. Interviews were coded using an inductive and deductive approach to identify emergent themes.  

Results: Participants described the intervention as having positive impacts on their families, including improved ability to meet basic needs, investments in family health and child safety, and increased opportunities for parent-child bonding. Participants often reflected that earlier access to these benefits could have mitigated the circumstances that led to their child welfare referrals. Some participants expressed initial skepticism about the program due to fear of further family surveillance. Despite their reticence to engage with child welfare, participants universally expressed a positive opinion of the program.  

Conclusions: These findings suggest that unconditional cash transfers may be a promising intervention to mitigate child welfare involvement. Future research should explore the impacts of cash transfers programs on family perceptions of and trust in child welfare.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了儿童福利系统中无条件现金转移支付对家庭的影响。研究发现，每月500美元的无条件现金转移支付能帮助家庭满足基本需求、改善家庭健康和儿童安全，并增加亲子互动机会。
AI.research_question: 无条件现金转移支付对儿童福利系统中的父母和家庭有何感知影响？
AI.motivation: 贫困相关需求与儿童福利介入相关，但很少有儿童福利系统研究无条件现金转移支付对父母和家庭的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贫困与儿童福利介入关系的理论框架，探讨现金转移支付作为干预机制的效果。
AI.method: 在随机对照试验中，对40名分配到治疗组的父母进行半结构化访谈，采用归纳和演绎方法进行主题分析。
AI.findings: 参与者认为干预对家庭有积极影响：改善基本需求满足能力、投资家庭健康和儿童安全、增加亲子互动机会。早期获得这些福利可能减轻导致儿童福利转介的情况。尽管最初对儿童福利系统有疑虑，但所有参与者都对项目持积极看法。
AI.theory_contributions: 为儿童福利系统中现金转移支付的理论框架提供实证支持，表明经济支持可能减少儿童福利介入。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议儿童福利系统考虑采用无条件现金转移支付作为干预措施，未来研究应探索此类项目对家庭信任和感知的影响。

title: Robust Time-series Generation under Extreme Data Scarcity: An Engineering Benchmarking Study of Fuzzy and Lyapunov-regularized Adversarial Networks

detail.title: Robust Time-series Generation under Extreme Data Scarcity: An Engineering Benchmarking Study of Fuzzy and Lyapunov-regularized Adversarial Networks
detail.abstract:
Time-series generation under extreme data scarcity poses a fundamental challenge for machine learning systems deployed in decision-critical domains such as epidemiological monitoring, financial risk analysis, and engineering forecasting. While modern generative models perform well in data-rich settings, their reliability degrades sharply when available observations are severely limited, often leading to unstable training and poor temporal consistency. 
     This paper presents a stability-aware generative framework, referred to as FGAN, which integrates fuzzy regime modeling with Lyapunov-inspired regularization to improve robustness in ultra-scarce data regimes. Fuzzy memberships provide uncertainty-aware representations of partially observable temporal states, while the Lyapunov-based regularizer constrains generator sensitivity and suppresses unstable or chaotic dynamics during adversarial training. 
     A comprehensive empirical evaluation is conducted against seven state-of-the-art generative baselines across three real-world application domains: cholera surveillance, influenza-like illness monitoring, and financial volatility modeling. Experiments span multiple data availability levels and employ a unified set of evaluation metrics covering distributional fidelity, temporal structure preservation, forecasting utility, and privacy-related characteristics. 
     Results demonstrate that FGAN consistently outperforms competing methods across all scarcity levels, achieving substantial improvements in distributional accuracy and temporal coherence, while maintaining favorable performance–efficiency trade-offs. These findings indicate that stability-aware fuzzy–Lyapunov regularization offers a practical and effective foundation for reliable time-series generation in data-poor engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FGAN框架，通过模糊机制建模和Lyapunov正则化解决极端数据稀缺下的时间序列生成问题，在多个实际应用中优于现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在极端数据稀缺条件下实现可靠的时间序列生成？
AI.motivation: 时间序列生成在流行病监测、金融风险分析、工程预测等关键决策领域至关重要，但现有生成模型在数据严重稀缺时性能急剧下降，导致训练不稳定和时间一致性差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模糊机制建模（提供不确定性感知的时间状态表示）和Lyapunov稳定性理论（通过正则化约束生成器敏感性和抑制不稳定动态）。
AI.method: 提出FGAN框架，整合模糊成员函数和Lyapunov启发式正则化，在对抗训练中约束生成器敏感性，抑制不稳定或混沌动态。
AI.findings: FGAN在所有稀缺水平上一致优于7个最先进的生成基线方法，在分布准确性和时间一致性方面实现显著改进，同时保持有利的性能-效率权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了稳定性感知的模糊-Lyapunov正则化框架，为数据稀缺条件下的时间序列生成提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为霍乱监测、流感样疾病监测和金融波动建模等实际应用提供了可靠的生成解决方案，在分布保真度、时间结构保持、预测效用和隐私特性方面表现优异。

title: Export Intensity & SMEs' Access to Bank Finance: Evidence from SAFE Database
affiliations: University of Glasgow - Adam Smith Business School, University of Glasgow, Faculty of Social Sciences, Department of Economics, Students, University of Glasgow and University of Glasgow - Department of Economics

detail.title: Export Intensity & SMEs' Access to Bank Finance: Evidence from SAFE Database
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the COVID-19 shock altered SMEs' financing conditions asymmetrically by international exposure. We use the ECB Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises (SAFE) for 2014-2022 to build firm-level measures of credit constraints based on loan application outcomes, and estimate a difference-indifferences specification interacting a post-COVID indicator with continuous export intensity. Export-intensive SMEs experience a disproportionate tightening of credit constraints after the pandemic onset, with effects concentrated in bank loans rather than credit lines. Measures of financing needs and application behavior show no differential increase in credit demand among exporters, supporting a credit-supply interpretation. The tightening is mainly explained by quantity rationing-exporters are more likely to receive smaller loan amounts than requested-consistent with banks scaling back exposures under elevated trade uncertainty. The findings highlight a financial amplification channel through which trade disruptions can impair SME activity even amid extensive policy support.

AI.tldr: COVID-19冲击对中小企业融资条件产生不对称影响，出口密集型企业面临更严重的信贷约束收紧，主要表现为银行贷款额度减少而非信贷额度，这反映了贸易不确定性下银行的风险规避行为。
AI.research_question: COVID-19冲击是否根据企业的国际化程度对中小企业融资条件产生不对称影响？
AI.motivation: 理解疫情冲击如何通过金融渠道影响不同国际化程度的中小企业，特别是在广泛政策支持背景下，贸易中断如何通过融资约束放大对实体经济的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷约束理论、国际贸易与金融关联、不确定性下的银行风险规避行为、金融加速器理论。
AI.method: 使用欧洲央行中小企业融资调查（SAFE）2014-2022年数据，构建基于贷款申请结果的信贷约束指标，采用双重差分法，将疫情后指标与连续出口强度变量交互。
AI.findings: 出口密集型中小企业在疫情后经历不成比例的信贷约束收紧，效应主要集中在银行贷款而非信贷额度；融资需求和申请行为未显示出口企业信贷需求有差异增加，支持信贷供给解释；收紧主要由数量配给解释——出口企业更可能获得比申请金额更小的贷款，与银行在贸易不确定性升高时缩减敞口一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了贸易中断通过金融渠道放大对中小企业影响的机制，扩展了不确定性下银行风险规避行为理论，为金融加速器理论在国际贸易背景下的应用提供实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性干预依据，帮助银行更好评估贸易风险下的信贷决策，提醒出口企业关注融资环境变化，即使在广泛政策支持背景下仍需关注特定群体的融资约束。

title: Handbook of Research on base of the Pyramid Entrepreneurship - Introduction
affiliations: and Suffolk University

detail.title: Handbook of Research on base of the Pyramid Entrepreneurship - Introduction
detail.abstract: This introductory chapter sets the stage for the Handbook's exploration of entrepreneurship at the Base of the Pyramid (BoP), a field that has evolved significantly since its emergence over two decades ago. We outline the unique characteristics of BoP entrepreneurship, including the profile of BoP entrepreneurs, the diversity of actors active at the BoP, the complexity of BoP contexts, and the innovative business models that arise in those contexts. We highlight how BoP entrepreneurship presents unique opportunity to challenge and enrich mainstream entrepreneurship theory and methodology, and management more generally. This introductory chapter also presents the structure of the Handbook, which is organized into three parts: (1) Understanding the Field: Theoretical and Empirical Perspectives, (2) Delving into the Setting: The BoP Context for Entrepreneurs and Its Varieties, and (3) Emerging Issues in BoP Entrepreneurship, and introduces each chapter one by one.

AI.tldr: 这篇引言章节介绍了金字塔底层创业手册，概述了BoP创业的独特特征、对主流创业理论的挑战与丰富，以及手册的三部分结构。
AI.research_question: 如何理解金字塔底层创业的独特特征及其对主流创业理论和管理的贡献？
AI.motivation: 金字塔底层创业作为一个已有20多年发展历史的领域，具有独特的特征和复杂性，需要系统梳理和理论化，以挑战和丰富主流创业理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金字塔底层创业理论、创业理论、创新商业模式理论、制度理论
AI.method: 文献综述、概念分析、手册章节介绍
AI.findings: 1. BoP创业具有独特特征：BoP创业者特征、多元参与者、复杂环境背景、创新商业模式；2. BoP创业为挑战和丰富主流创业理论提供了独特机会；3. 手册分为三部分：理解领域、深入情境、新兴议题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统梳理BoP创业的独特理论特征；2. 提出BoP创业对主流创业理论的挑战与丰富路径；3. 建立BoP创业研究的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为BoP创业者提供实践指导；2. 为政策制定者提供BoP创业支持框架；3. 为企业进入BoP市场提供商业模式创新参考。

title: Optimal Incentives and the Price of Information in Sequential Production with Private Costs
affiliations: and Hong Kong Polytechnic University

detail.title: Optimal Incentives and the Price of Information in Sequential Production with Private Costs
detail.abstract: We characterize optimal investment-inducing mechanisms for sequential production processes with private costs and quantify the price of information relative to Winter (2006). In our model, a project consists of n tasks performed sequentially by n agents. Each agent decides whether to invest in her task, paying a privately known cost and guaranteeing success, or to shirk, in which case the task succeeds only probabilistically. The principal commits to a reward vector contingent on overall project success and seeks a mechanism that induces all agents to invest in the unique subgame-perfect equilibrium while minimizing total rewards uniformly over all admissible cost profiles. We first show that a natural extension of Winter's optimal mechanism under public costs fails to guarantee investment when costs are private and that simple "robust" uniform reward schemes are strictly suboptimal. We then fully characterize optimal investment-inducing mechanisms under private costs. For homogeneous costs, we derive a closed-form asymmetric reward vector that guarantees investment and minimizes total reward. For heterogeneous costs with a common non-investment success probability, the optimal mechanism is uniform across agents and depends only on the upper bounds of their cost supports. When task importance (non-investment success probabilities) is non-uniform, we obtain closed-form optimal rewards for any assignment of tasks and agents, and identify optimal task-agent matching. Finally, we introduce a notion of the price of information (PoI): the supremum over instances of the ratio between the optimal total reward under private costs and that under public costs. We establish that the PoI grows on the order of n/ log n in the homogeneouscost model, is exactly nr in the heterogeneous-cost model when cost supports are bounded by a factor r, and is unbounded when task importance varies sufficiently across tasks. We also extend the analysis to probability thresholds for project success, obtaining analogous results in a probability-constrained formulation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在顺序生产过程中，当代理人的成本为私有信息时，如何设计最优的投资激励机制。项目包含n个顺序执行的任务，每个代理人决定是否投资（支付私有成本保证成功）或偷懒（仅概率性成功）。委托人承诺基于项目整体成功给予奖励，寻求在唯一子博弈完美均衡中诱导所有代理人投资，同时最小化总奖励。研究发现，公开成本下的最优机制在私有成本下失效，本文完全刻画了私有成本下的最优机制，并量化了信息价格（PoI）。
AI.research_question: 在顺序生产过程中，当代理人的投资成本为私有信息时，如何设计最优的投资激励机制？信息价格（私有成本相对于公开成本）是多少？
AI.motivation: Winter (2006) 研究了公开成本下的最优激励机制，但现实世界中代理人的成本通常是私有信息。需要理解私有信息如何影响激励机制设计，以及信息不对称带来的额外成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、博弈论（子博弈完美均衡）、顺序生产模型、信息经济学、激励相容约束
AI.method: 理论建模与分析：构建顺序生产过程的博弈模型，代理人私有成本，委托人设计基于项目整体成功的奖励机制。使用优化方法求解最小化总奖励的激励相容机制，分析不同成本结构下的最优解。
AI.findings: 1. 公开成本下的最优机制在私有成本下失效；2. 简单的均匀奖励方案是次优的；3. 同质成本下，最优奖励向量是非对称的闭式解；4. 异质成本但非投资成功概率相同时，最优机制是均匀的，仅取决于成本上界；5. 任务重要性不同时，获得闭式最优奖励并识别最优任务-代理人匹配；6. 信息价格（PoI）在同质成本模型中按n/log n增长，在异质成本模型中为nr，当任务重要性差异足够大时无界。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 完全刻画了顺序生产过程中私有成本下的最优投资激励机制；2. 引入了信息价格（PoI）概念，量化了信息不对称的成本；3. 扩展了Winter (2006)的公开成本模型到私有信息环境；4. 提供了不同成本结构下的闭式解和最优匹配结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者设计多阶段项目激励机制提供理论指导；2. 帮助理解信息不对称带来的额外激励成本；3. 提供任务分配和奖励结构设计的优化方案；4. 对项目成功概率约束的扩展分析具有实际应用价值。

title: How Much Financial Flexibility Is Optimal? A Closed-form Capital Structure Model for Investment-grade Firms
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: How Much Financial Flexibility Is Optimal? A Closed-form Capital Structure Model for Investment-grade Firms
detail.abstract: Investment-grade (IG) firms often manage capital structure by preserving financial flexibility and rating resilience rather than targeting a precise leverage ratio. I develop a tractable continuous-time model in which the key financing choice is contractual headroom: the firm selects a trigger threshold V g at which debt pricing steps up and reverts upon recovery. Optimal V g trades off tax benefits against expected trigger-based tightening costs and an issuance-time concession tied to headroom, yielding a closed-form interior solution. Implied leverage follows endogenously, and a simple Debt/EBITDA mapping expresses the policy in familiar covenant terms. Comparative statics provide clear predictions for how headroom and implied leverage vary with taxes, repricing severity, and debt-service burden.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个连续时间模型，研究投资级公司如何通过设定"契约性缓冲空间"（债务定价触发阈值V_g）来管理资本结构，而非追求精确的杠杆比率。模型权衡了税收优惠、触发成本和新发债优惠，得出了封闭式最优解。
AI.research_question: 投资级公司如何通过设定债务定价触发阈值（契约性缓冲空间）来优化资本结构管理？
AI.motivation: 投资级公司通常通过保持财务灵活性和评级韧性来管理资本结构，而不是追求精确的杠杆比率。现有文献缺乏对这种基于触发机制的资本结构管理方式的建模分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间金融模型、资本结构理论、债务契约理论、税收优惠与财务困境成本权衡理论
AI.method: 构建一个可处理的连续时间模型，其中公司选择债务定价触发阈值V_g。当公司价值达到V_g时，债务定价会上升，恢复后则回落。模型通过权衡税收优惠、预期触发紧缩成本和新发债优惠来求解最优V_g。
AI.findings: 模型得出了最优触发阈值V_g的封闭式内部解。隐含杠杆率是内生决定的，可以通过简单的债务/EBITDA映射将政策表达为熟悉的契约条款。比较静态分析显示了缓冲空间和隐含杠杆率如何随税收、重新定价严重性和偿债负担而变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一个基于触发机制的资本结构管理新模型；2）将契约性缓冲空间作为核心融资选择；3）提供了投资级公司资本结构管理的理论解释；4）建立了债务/EBITDA映射的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为投资级公司提供了基于触发阈值的资本结构管理框架；2）帮助公司理解如何设定债务契约缓冲空间；3）提供了债务/EBITDA比率的理论依据；4）为债务契约设计提供了指导。

title: Child Protection, Juvenile Justice, and Social Rehabilitation in Africa: Law, Policy, and Practice

detail.title: Child Protection, Juvenile Justice, and Social Rehabilitation in Africa: Law, Policy, and Practice
detail.abstract:
The paper provides a study on child protection, juvenile justice and social rehabilitation using data across Africa as the focal point. It explores the interconnected socio-legal system shaping the safety experience for young people, the effectiveness of reintegration, the extent of marginalisation and the frequency of recurring harm. The paper analyses the extent to which normative commitments through the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child and the African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child are implemented, and addresses any gaps. The treaties have been ratified to a large extent, and there is evidence to show the permeation of child-focused legislation, yet the argument is based on constraints on the outcomes stemming from poorly resourced social welfare services, incompetency and limitation of specialised staff within, especially the police and courts, overreliance on the detention system, including that for minor offences and institutional mandates that are unfavourably fragmented.

The paper additionally discusses the effectiveness of diversion and restorative justice, thus, making sure it respects due process and alternatives to punitive justice with cultural sensitivity. It highlights programme access and availability disparities and the challenge of the lack of safeguards that protect victims from coercion and other threats. It discusses a paradigm shift from social rehabilitation rooted in individualism to the notion of social inclusion, where change is based on continuous education, family-based support systems, psychosocial and mental health services, and reintegration models that are community-based.   The paper draws the conclusion that reforms can only be sustainable through a robust rehabilitation infrastructure; this would imply that reforms are child-centred, dependent upon due process, enshrined in community service systems which are designed to bridge child protection and juvenile justice. It would imply that dignity and participation become the central focus in the reformation process, notwithstanding a workforce that is well-resourced and adequately trained. Without these changes, legal reform will only contribute to entrenching exclusion and do very little to advancing social cohesion and public safety.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了非洲儿童保护、少年司法和社会康复系统的现状，探讨了联合国《儿童权利公约》和《非洲儿童权利与福利宪章》的实施情况，指出了资源不足、专业人才缺乏、过度依赖拘留等问题，并提出了以儿童为中心、基于正当程序、社区为本的改革方向。
AI.research_question: 非洲儿童保护、少年司法和社会康复系统在多大程度上实施了国际儿童权利规范？这些系统的有效性如何？存在哪些实施差距和挑战？
AI.motivation: 尽管非洲国家广泛批准了国际儿童权利条约，并制定了相关立法，但儿童保护、少年司法和社会康复系统的实际效果仍面临诸多挑战，需要系统性地分析问题根源并提出可持续的改革方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联合国《儿童权利公约》和《非洲儿童权利与福利宪章》的规范框架，结合社会康复、社会包容、正当程序、儿童中心主义等理论概念。
AI.method: 使用非洲范围内的数据进行分析，采用文献分析、政策评估和系统分析的方法，考察法律实施、服务提供和实际效果之间的差距。
AI.findings: 1. 条约批准率高但实施存在显著差距；2. 社会福利服务资源不足，专业人才缺乏；3. 警察和法院系统能力有限；4. 过度依赖拘留系统，包括轻微犯罪；5. 机构职责分散且不协调；6. 分流和恢复性司法项目存在可及性和保障不足问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从基于个人主义的社会康复范式向社会包容范式的转变，强调持续教育、家庭支持、心理服务和社区为本的重新融入模式，为儿童保护与少年司法整合提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可持续改革的实践路径：1. 建立强大的康复基础设施；2. 以儿童为中心的设计；3. 基于正当程序；4. 嵌入社区服务体系；5. 以尊严和参与为核心；6. 配备充足资源和训练有素的工作人员。

title: Automated Routing, Patent Examiner Specialization and Quasi-random Assignment at the USPTO
affiliations: United States Patent and Trademark Office and EMLV

detail.title: Automated Routing, Patent Examiner Specialization and Quasi-random Assignment at the USPTO
detail.abstract: In October 2020, the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) introduced an automated process for routing new patent applications, in part to increase examiner specialization. In this research note, we first assess whether the USPTO achieved this objective using a difference-indifferences (DiD) research design on a sample of applications assigned to examiners between 2018 and 2021. The new routing system increased technical overlap between examiner work histories and newly assigned cases by nearly 57 percent, indicating a substantial increase in examiner specialization across the agency. In addition, we show that automated routinglargely unknown in the academic literature-effectively eliminated quasi-random assignment of applications to examiners. Given the importance of quasi-random assignment for empirical research, we discuss our findings within this context and their potential impact on future research.

AI.tldr: USPTO引入自动化专利申请分配系统，提高了审查员专业化程度（技术匹配度增加57%），但破坏了准随机分配机制，对实证研究有重要影响
AI.research_question: USPTO的自动化专利申请分配系统是否成功提高了审查员的专业化程度？该系统对专利申请的准随机分配机制有何影响？
AI.motivation: USPTO在2020年10月引入自动化专利申请分配系统，旨在提高审查员的专业化程度。需要评估该系统是否达到预期目标，并分析其对实证研究中常用的准随机分配机制的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织专业化理论、技术匹配理论、准随机分配在实证研究中的重要性、自动化系统对组织流程的影响
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DiD）研究设计，分析2018-2021年间分配给审查员的专利申请样本，评估自动化分配系统对审查员专业化的影响
AI.findings: 1. 新分配系统使审查员工作经历与新分配案件的技术重叠度增加了近57%，表明审查员专业化程度显著提高；2. 自动化分配系统有效消除了专利申请的准随机分配机制
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为自动化系统对组织专业化的影响提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了自动化流程如何改变组织内部的分配机制；3. 强调了准随机分配机制在实证研究中的脆弱性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为USPTO评估其自动化系统效果提供了实证依据；2. 提醒未来研究者注意自动化分配系统对研究设计的影响；3. 为其他专利机构或类似组织引入自动化系统提供参考

title: Since the Bureau Acknowledges it Protects Competition in Future Markets, it must also Acknowledge that it Applies the Future Markets Model
affiliations: Bridgeline Solutions

detail.title: Since the Bureau Acknowledges it Protects Competition in Future Markets, it must also Acknowledge that it Applies the Future Markets Model
detail.abstract: In its draft Merger Enforcement Guidelines the Competition Bureau Canada acknowledges that when it protects competition to innovate it protects competition in Future Markets, markets for products at least some of which do not exist yet.  The Bureau has thus recognized, as the author had previously suggested it should, that it cannot directly protect competition to innovate (as the European Commission claims it can).  The Bureau should now take the next logical step and acknowledge that when it analyzes competition in Future Markets it applies the Future Markets Model.  It must apply the Model; its just a matter of logic.

AI.tldr: 加拿大竞争局在合并执法指南草案中承认，保护创新竞争就是保护未来市场竞争，但作者认为这还不够，需要明确应用未来市场模型进行分析。
AI.research_question: 加拿大竞争局在分析创新竞争时，是否应该明确承认并应用未来市场模型？
AI.motivation: 加拿大竞争局在合并执法指南草案中承认保护创新竞争就是保护未来市场竞争，但作者认为这还不够，需要明确应用未来市场模型进行分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未来市场模型理论框架，用于分析尚未存在的产品的市场竞争。
AI.method: 理论分析和逻辑推理，基于加拿大竞争局现有政策文件的分析。
AI.findings: 加拿大竞争局已经承认保护创新竞争就是保护未来市场竞争，但尚未明确承认应用未来市场模型。
